org:abin.resumo: Central body of the Brazilian Intelligence System: plans, carries out and coordinates the country's intelligence work to advise the President. Part of the Chief of Staff's Office (Casa Civil).

org:aeronautica.resumo: The air force: one of the three Armed Forces, directed and managed by the Commander of the Air Force.

org:agencias-reguladoras-federais.resumo: The twelve special-regime autonomous agencies that Lei 13.848/2019 calls regulatory agencies: they regulate and oversee sectors with autonomy, and their directors serve fixed terms of office.

org:agu.nome: Office of the Attorney General of the Union
org:agu.resumo: Institution that represents the Union in court and gives legal advice to the Executive Branch. It is headed by the Attorney General of the Union.

org:ana.nome: National Water and Basic Sanitation Agency
org:ana.resumo: Federal regulatory agency that implements the National Water Resources Policy, grants rights to use water under federal control and issues reference standards for sanitation.

org:anac.resumo: Federal regulatory agency that regulates and oversees civil aviation and aeronautical and airport infrastructure.

org:anatel.resumo: Federal regulatory agency for telecommunications: grants licences for and oversees the services, manages the radio-frequency spectrum and protects users' rights.

org:ancine.resumo: Federal regulatory agency that promotes, regulates and oversees the film and audiovisual industry.

org:aneel.resumo: Federal regulatory agency that regulates and oversees the generation, transmission, distribution and sale of electricity.

org:anm.resumo: Federal regulatory agency that manages mining titles, regulates and oversees mining and collects the financial compensation for the extraction of minerals (CFEM).

org:anp.nome: National Agency of Petroleum, Natural Gas and Biofuels
org:anp.resumo: Federal regulatory agency that regulates, contracts and oversees the exploration, production, refining and supply of oil, natural gas and biofuels.

org:anpd.resumo: Federal regulatory agency responsible for protecting personal data: issues regulations, oversees data processing and applies the penalties of the LGPD.

org:ans.resumo: Federal regulatory agency for private health plans: registers operators and plans, sets minimum coverage, authorises price increases and oversees the sector.

org:antaq.resumo: Federal regulatory agency for river, coastal and ocean shipping, public ports and port facilities.

org:antt.resumo: Federal regulatory agency for rail transport, interstate and international road passenger transport, freight transport and federal highways under concession.

org:anvisa.resumo: Federal autonomous agency that regulates, controls and inspects products and services that pose health risks, such as medicines, food and cosmetics, and coordinates the national health surveillance system.

org:arquetipo-estadual-assembleia-legisl.resumo: The state's parliament, with a single House, made up of state deputies elected for four-year terms.

org:arquetipo-estadual-camaras-do-tribun.nome: Chambers, panels and sections of the State Court of Justice
org:arquetipo-estadual-camaras-do-tribun.resumo: Divisions of the State Court of Justice (TJ), usually specialised by subject, that decide most appeals. Each one works as a separate court.

org:arquetipo-estadual-centro-de-estudos.nome: Centre for Studies and Professional Development of the Public Prosecution Service
org:arquetipo-estadual-centro-de-estudos.resumo: Auxiliary body of the state Public Prosecution Service that runs courses, seminars, research and publications to train its members and staff.

org:arquetipo-estadual-centros-de-apoio-.nome: Operational Support Centres of the Public Prosecution Service
org:arquetipo-estadual-centros-de-apoio-.resumo: Auxiliary bodies of the state Public Prosecution Service that connect and inform the prosecutors working in the same field, without acting in cases themselves.

org:arquetipo-estadual-colegio-de-procur.nome: College of Senior Prosecutors (Procuradores de Justiça)
org:arquetipo-estadual-colegio-de-procur.resumo: Brings together all the state's senior prosecutors. It elects the Inspector General, approves the Public Prosecution Service's budget and may propose to the Legislature the removal of the Prosecutor General.

org:arquetipo-estadual-comarcas.nome: Judicial districts (comarcas) and courts of the state judiciary
org:arquetipo-estadual-comarcas.resumo: Divisions of the state's territory where first-instance state judges work. Larger districts have several courts.

org:arquetipo-estadual-comissao-interges.resumo: Forum where the state and its municipalities agree on the organisation of the health network and the shared management of SUS in the state.
Forum where the state and its municipalities agree on the organisation of the state social assistance system and the management of Suas in the state.

org:arquetipo-estadual-comissao-triparti.resumo: Forum with equal representation of the Executives of the Federal Government, the state and the municipalities, to promote shared and decentralised environmental management in the state.

org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-da-magis.nome: Judiciary Council of the State Court of Justice
org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-da-magis.resumo: Collegiate body of the State Court of Justice with disciplinary powers over judges. The President, the Vice-President and the Inspector General are members by right.

org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-de-assis.resumo: Council with equal numbers of government and civil society members that decides on social assistance in the state, approves the sector's budget proposal and controls the state fund.

org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-de-educa.resumo: Standard-setting council of the state education system, with representatives of government and civil society; its rules require ratification by the Executive.

org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-de-meio-.resumo: The state's environmental council; it defines which activities have local impact and are therefore licensed by the municipalities.

org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-de-saude.resumo: Permanent decision-making council of SUS in the state, with half of its members representing users. Its decisions are ratified by the governor.

org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-de-segur.nome: State Council for Public Security and Social Defence
org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-de-segur.resumo: Advisory council on public security in the state, created by a law proposed by the governor, with representatives of the Susp bodies, the justice system and civil society.

org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-do-funde.nome: State Council for Monitoring and Social Control of Fundeb
org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-do-funde.resumo: Monitors and controls the distribution and use of Fundeb money in the state; it may summon the education secretary and request documents.

org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-superior.nome: Higher Council of the State Public Defender's Office
org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-superior.resumo: Advisory, standard-setting and decision-making body of the state Public Defender's Office, chaired by the Public Defender General. It chooses the Ombudsman General and draws up the list for Inspector General.

org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-superior.nome: Higher Council of the Civil Police
org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-superior.resumo: Collegiate body of the Civil Police, chaired by the Chief of the Civil Police, with representatives of every permanent post in the force.

org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-superior.nome: Higher Council of the State Public Prosecution Service
org:arquetipo-estadual-conselho-superior.resumo: Collegiate body of the state Public Prosecution Service that draws up the lists for promotion, transfer and the constitutional fifth, decides on confirmation in office for life and reviews the closing of civil inquiries.

org:arquetipo-estadual-corpo-de-bombeiro.resumo: Carries out civil defence activities in the state, besides the duties the law gives it. It is an auxiliary and reserve force of the Army and reports to the governor.

org:arquetipo-estadual-corregedoria-gera.nome: Office of the Inspector General of the State Public Defender's Office
org:arquetipo-estadual-corregedoria-gera.resumo: Oversees the professional work and conduct of the members and staff of the state Public Defender's Office. It is run by the Inspector General.

org:arquetipo-estadual-corregedoria-gera.nome: Office of the Inspector General of the Civil Police
org:arquetipo-estadual-corregedoria-gera.resumo: Carries out internal control and inspection of the Civil Police and investigates disciplinary and criminal offences committed by its staff on duty. It is autonomous.

org:arquetipo-estadual-corregedoria-gera.nome: Office of the Inspector General of the State Public Prosecution Service
org:arquetipo-estadual-corregedoria-gera.resumo: Guides and oversees the professional work and conduct of members of the state Public Prosecution Service. It is headed by the Inspector General, elected by the College of Senior Prosecutors.

org:arquetipo-estadual-defensoria-public.resumo: Provides free legal advice and defence to people who cannot pay, in cases before the state courts. Headed by the Public Defender General.

org:arquetipo-estadual-eleitorado.resumo: The state's voters. They elect the governor, the vice-governor and state deputies, and may propose state bills.

org:arquetipo-estadual-escola-superior-d.resumo: Body for training, professional development, research and outreach of the Civil Police; it takes part in the competitive examinations for posts in the force.

org:arquetipo-estadual-governadoria.resumo: Head of the state Executive Branch, held by the governor. The vice-governor is also in this node.

org:arquetipo-estadual-ministerio-public.resumo: Each state's Public Prosecution Service: it acts before the state courts and is headed by the Prosecutor General of Justice.

org:arquetipo-estadual-mp-de-contas.nome: Public Prosecution Service at the State Court of Accounts
org:arquetipo-estadual-mp-de-contas.resumo: Special Public Prosecution Service that acts before the state court of accounts. It is part of the court's structure and is distinct from the state Public Prosecution Service.

org:arquetipo-estadual-orgao-especial-do.nome: Special Body of the State Court of Justice
org:arquetipo-estadual-orgao-especial-do.resumo: In State Courts of Justice with more than 25 appellate judges, it performs the administrative and judicial functions of the Full Court. It has 11 to 25 members.

org:arquetipo-estadual-orgao-executivo-d.resumo: Licenses drivers, registers and licenses vehicles and enforces traffic rules in the state; the first two tasks are delegated by the Federal Government.

org:arquetipo-estadual-ouvidoria-geral-d.nome: Ombudsman's Office of the State Public Defender's Office
org:arquetipo-estadual-ouvidoria-geral-d.resumo: Auxiliary body of the state Public Defender's Office that receives and forwards complaints and suggestions from the public, headed by someone from outside the career.

org:arquetipo-estadual-poder-executivo.resumo: The Executive Branch of each state, headed by the governor, who is elected together with the vice-governor for four years.

org:arquetipo-estadual-poder-legislativo.resumo: The Legislative Branch of each state, exercised by the State Legislative Assembly, with a single House. The State Court of Accounts assists it with external control.

org:arquetipo-estadual-policia-civil.resumo: The state's judicial police: investigates criminal offences, except military ones and those under federal jurisdiction. It is headed by a career police chief (delegado).

org:arquetipo-estadual-policia-militar.resumo: Carries out visible, preventive policing and maintains public order in the state. It is an auxiliary and reserve force of the Army and reports to the governor.

org:arquetipo-estadual-policia-penal.resumo: Responsible for security in the state's prisons. It is attached to the body that runs the prison system and reports to the governor.

org:arquetipo-estadual-procuradoria-gera.resumo: The state's public advocacy body: represents the state in court and gives legal advice to the state government.

org:arquetipo-estadual-procuradorias-de-.nome: Offices of Senior Prosecutors (Procuradorias de Justiça)
org:arquetipo-estadual-procuradorias-de-.resumo: Administrative bodies of the state Public Prosecution Service with posts of senior prosecutor, who act before the courts of appeal.

org:arquetipo-estadual-promotorias-de-ju.resumo: Administrative bodies of the state Public Prosecution Service with at least one post of prosecutor (promotor de justiça); they may act in court or out of court, in general or specialised matters.

org:arquetipo-estadual-regioes-metropoli.nome: Metropolitan regions, urban agglomerations and micro-regions
org:arquetipo-estadual-regioes-metropoli.resumo: Groups of neighbouring municipalities set up by state complementary law to plan and carry out together public functions of common interest.

org:arquetipo-estadual-regioes-metropoli.nome: Deliberative collegiate body of metropolitan governance
org:arquetipo-estadual-regioes-metropoli.resumo: Collegiate body of the metropolitan region or urban agglomeration with civil society representation; it approves the integrated urban development plan.
Made up of representatives of the Executives of the state and of the municipalities of the metropolitan region or urban agglomeration.

org:arquetipo-estadual-regioes-metropoli.nome: Technical and advisory organisation of metropolitan governance
org:arquetipo-estadual-regioes-metropoli.resumo: Public organisation with technical and advisory functions in the governance of the metropolitan region or urban agglomeration.

org:arquetipo-estadual-secretaria-de-ass.resumo: Body that manages social assistance in the state: coordinates Suas at its level, manages the state social assistance fund and supports the council.

org:arquetipo-estadual-secretaria-de-sau.resumo: Runs SUS in the state: decentralises services to the municipalities, monitors the SUS networks, supports the municipalities and provides services where they fall short.

org:arquetipo-estadual-secretarias.resumo: Bodies of the state's direct administration, each headed by a Secretary of State. Their number and names vary from state to state.

org:arquetipo-estadual-servicos-notariai.resumo: Notary and registry offices run by private individuals under delegation from the State, selected by competitive examination and supervised by each state's judiciary.

org:arquetipo-estadual-sistema-de-ensino.resumo: Includes the schools run by the state, private primary and secondary schools and the state education bodies. It works mainly in primary and secondary education.

org:arquetipo-estadual-tce.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state and, as a rule, the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities.

org:arquetipo-estadual-tribunal-de-justi.resumo: Second-instance court of the state judiciary. Each state has its own; the state constitution defines its jurisdiction.

org:arquetipo-estadual-unidade-gestora-d.nome: Managing unit of the state's own pension scheme
org:arquetipo-estadual-unidade-gestora-d.resumo: Single body or entity that manages the retirement and survivors' pensions of permanent civil servants of all the state's Branches and bodies (own pension scheme).

org:arquetipo-municipal-camara-municipal.resumo: The municipality's Legislative Branch: makes local laws, votes on the organic law and oversees the mayor, with the help of a court of accounts.

org:arquetipo-municipal-conselho-de-assi.resumo: Council with equal numbers of government and civil society members that decides on social assistance in the municipality, registers and oversees assistance organisations and controls the municipal fund.

org:arquetipo-municipal-conselho-de-educ.resumo: Standard-setting council of the municipal education system, with representatives of government and civil society; its rules require ratification by the Executive.

org:arquetipo-municipal-conselho-de-saud.resumo: Permanent decision-making council of SUS in the municipality, with half of its members representing users. Its decisions are ratified by the mayor.

org:arquetipo-municipal-conselho-de-segu.nome: Municipal Council for Public Security and Social Defence
org:arquetipo-municipal-conselho-de-segu.resumo: Advisory council on public security in the municipality, created by a law proposed by the mayor, with representatives of the Susp bodies and civil society.

org:arquetipo-municipal-conselho-do-fund.nome: Municipal Council for Monitoring and Social Control of Fundeb
org:arquetipo-municipal-conselho-do-fund.resumo: Monitors and controls the distribution and use of Fundeb money in the municipality; it may summon the education secretary and request documents.

org:arquetipo-municipal-controle-interno.nome: Internal control of the municipal Executive
org:arquetipo-municipal-controle-interno.resumo: Internal control system that the municipality's Executive Branch must maintain, alongside external control by the Municipal Council.

org:arquetipo-municipal-eleitorado.resumo: The municipality's voters. They elect the mayor, the deputy mayor and councillors, and may propose bills of local interest.

org:arquetipo-municipal-guarda-municipal.resumo: Protects the municipality's property, services and facilities. It is optional: each municipality decides by law whether to create one.

org:arquetipo-municipal-orgao-executivo-.resumo: Enforces traffic and parking rules on the municipality's roads, operates traffic lights and signs and issues fines, once the municipality has joined the National Traffic System.

org:arquetipo-municipal-poder-executivo.resumo: The Executive Branch of each municipality, headed by the mayor, who is elected together with the deputy mayor for four years.

org:arquetipo-municipal-poder-legislativ.resumo: The Legislative Branch of each municipality, exercised by the Municipal Council. It carries out external control with the help of a court of accounts.

org:arquetipo-municipal-prefeitura.resumo: Head of the municipal Executive Branch, held by the mayor. The deputy mayor is also in this node.

org:arquetipo-municipal-secretaria-de-as.resumo: Body that manages social assistance in the municipality: coordinates Suas at its level, manages the municipal social assistance fund and supports the council.

org:arquetipo-municipal-secretaria-de-sa.resumo: Runs SUS in the municipality: plans, manages and delivers local public health services, including health and epidemiological surveillance.

org:arquetipo-municipal-secretarias.resumo: Bodies of the municipality's direct administration, each headed by a municipal secretary. Their number and names vary from municipality to municipality.

org:arquetipo-municipal-sistema-de-ensin.resumo: Includes the schools run by the municipality, private nurseries and pre-schools and the municipal education bodies. It works mainly in early childhood and primary education.

org:arquetipo-municipal-unidade-gestora-.nome: Managing unit of the municipality's own pension scheme
org:arquetipo-municipal-unidade-gestora-.resumo: In municipalities that have their own pension scheme, the single body or entity that manages retirement and survivors' pensions of permanent civil servants of the mayor's office, the council, the autonomous agencies and the foundations.

org:assembleia-geral-dos-consorcios-publ.resumo: Highest body of each public consortium, in which each member government has at least one vote; it approves the statutes and decides on amendment and dissolution.

org:assessoria-de-relacoes-institucionai.nome: Institutional and Interfederative Relations Advisory Office of the CGIBS
org:assessoria-de-relacoes-institucionai.resumo: Handles the ombudsman service, communications and dialogue of the IBS Management Committee with the federal entities, Congress and taxpayers; it is run by the First Vice-President.

org:assessoria-especial-do-presidente.nome: Special Advisory Office of the President of the Republic
org:assessoria-especial-do-presidente.resumo: Advisory body of the Presidency that assists the President on foreign policy and national sovereignty and prepares the President's meetings and correspondence with foreign authorities.

org:auditoria-do-senado-federal.resumo: The Senate's internal audit unit: assesses whether the House's public funds are used properly and lawfully and supports external control by the TCU.

org:auditoria-interna-do-cgibs.resumo: Carries out internal control of the IBS Management Committee: oversees the acts of its managers and gives opinions on the annual report and the financial statements.

org:auditoria-militar-do-df.nome: Military Court (Auditoria) of the Federal District
org:auditoria-militar-do-df.resumo: First instance of the Military Justice of the Federal District: tries military crimes by the DF's military police and fire brigade members, with appeal to the TJDFT.

org:auditorias-da-justica-militar.nome: First-instance courts (Auditorias) of the Military Justice of the Union
org:auditorias-da-justica-militar.resumo: First-instance courts of the Military Justice of the Union, one or more in each of the country's 12 military judicial districts.

org:bancada-negra-da-camara.nome: Black Caucus of the Chamber of Deputies
org:bancada-negra-da-camara.resumo: Brings together Black deputies, based on self-declaration in their candidate registration, and takes part in party leaders' meetings with the right to speak and vote.

org:bancadas-estaduais-no-congresso-naci.nome: State delegations in the National Congress
org:bancadas-estaduais-no-congresso-naci.resumo: The federal deputies and senators of each state or the DF, grouped as a delegation: they present collective amendments to the federal budget for their state.

org:banco-central.resumo: Special autonomous agency, not attached to any ministry, that issues the currency, conducts monetary policy to keep prices stable and safeguards the financial system.

org:banco-do-brasil.resumo: Federal bank organised as a mixed-capital company; it carries out the government's credit policy and is the financial agent of the National Treasury.

org:bndes.resumo: Federal development bank, a state-owned company wholly owned by the Union, that finances investment with funds that include at least 28% of PIS/Pasep.

org:cade.resumo: Federal autonomous agency that prevents and punishes offences against the economic order, such as cartels, and approves or blocks mergers and acquisitions.

org:cae-senado.nome: Economic Affairs Committee of the Federal Senate
org:cae-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on the economic and financial aspects of bills, taxes, credit operations and the debt of the Federal Government, states and municipalities.

org:caixa-economica-federal.resumo: Federal bank organised as a state-owned company wholly owned by the Union: takes savings from the general public and finances housing and social programmes.

org:camara-de-coordenacao-e-revisao-do-m.nome: Coordination and Review Chamber of the Military Public Prosecution Service
org:camara-de-coordenacao-e-revisao-do-m.resumo: Body that coordinates, integrates and reviews the work of MPM members. It gives its opinion on the closing of military police inquiries.

org:camara-de-coordenacao-e-revisao-do-m.nome: Coordination and Review Chamber of the Labour Public Prosecution Service
org:camara-de-coordenacao-e-revisao-do-m.resumo: Body that coordinates, integrates and reviews the work of MPT members. It settles conflicts of powers between MPT bodies.

org:camara-de-recursos-da-previdencia-co.resumo: Final administrative instance for appeals against penalties and charges imposed by Previc on pension funds; seven members, four from the government and three from the sector.

org:camara-dos-deputados.resumo: House of the people's representatives: 513 deputies elected by proportional representation in each state and in the Federal District.

org:camara-legislativa-do-df.nome: Legislative Chamber of the Federal District
org:camara-legislativa-do-df.resumo: Parliament of the Federal District, with 24 district deputies. It plays the role of both a State Legislative Assembly and a Municipal Council.

org:camara-nacional-de-integracao-do-con.nome: National Chamber for the Integration of IBS and CBS Administrative Litigation
org:camara-nacional-de-integracao-do-con.resumo: Collegiate body of the Federal Government and the CGIBS that decides special appeals and incidental proceedings to standardise administrative case law on the rules common to IBS and CBS.

org:camara-superior-do-ibs.resumo: National instance for IBS litigation within the CGIBS that standardises case law on the tax's specific legislation and issues binding precedents for adjudicators.

org:camaras-de-coordenacao-e-revisao-do-.nome: Coordination and Review Chambers of the MPDFT
org:camaras-de-coordenacao-e-revisao-do-.resumo: Sector bodies of the MPDFT, organised by function or subject, that coordinate the work of its members and review the closing of civil and police inquiries.

org:camaras-de-coordenacao-e-revisao-do-.nome: Coordination and Review Chambers of the MPF
org:camaras-de-coordenacao-e-revisao-do-.resumo: Sector bodies of the MPF, organised by function or subject, that coordinate the work of its members and review the closing of inquiries.

org:camaras-de-julgamento-do-ibs.resumo: First instance of IBS administrative litigation within the CGIBS: 27 virtual chambers, one per state and one in the DF, that decide challenges to tax assessments issued by the authorities.

org:camaras-recursais-de-julgamento-do-i.resumo: Second instance of IBS administrative litigation within the CGIBS: 27 virtual chambers, one per state and one in the DF, with tax inspectors and taxpayer representatives.

org:capadr-camara.nome: Agriculture, Livestock, Supply and Rural Development Committee
org:capadr-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on agricultural and fisheries policy, rural credit, cooperatives, food supply, land reform and land tenure.

org:carf.resumo: Administrative tribunal of the Ministry of Finance, with equal numbers of government and taxpayer representatives, that decides at second instance disputes between taxpayers and the Federal Revenue Service over federal taxes.

org:cas-senado.nome: Social Affairs Committee of the Federal Senate
org:cas-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on labour relations, social security and pensions, social assistance and health.

org:casa-civil.nome: Chief of Staff's Office of the Presidency of the Republic (Casa Civil)
org:casa-civil.resumo: Body of the Presidency that directly assists the President: coordinates government action and monitors the ministries. Its head is a Minister of State.

org:casp-camara.nome: Public Administration and Public Service Committee
org:casp-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on the administrative organisation of the Federal Government, administrative law and the rules for civil servants.

org:ccai.nome: Joint Committee for the Control of Intelligence Activities
org:ccai.resumo: Standing committee of Congress that carries out external control and oversight of intelligence activity, especially of Sisbin.

org:ccdd-senado.nome: Communication and Digital Law Committee of the Federal Senate
org:ccdd-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on communications policy and law and innovation in communications.

org:ccj-senado.nome: Constitution, Justice and Citizenship Committee of the Federal Senate
org:ccj-senado.resumo: Senate committee that gives its opinion on whether bills are constitutional and legally sound, and on the merits of several legal subjects.

org:ccjc-camara.resumo: Chamber committee that examines whether every bill is constitutional and legally sound; an unfavourable opinion can end the bill.

org:ccom-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on the media, broadcasting, telecommunications and the internet.

org:cct-senado.nome: Science, Technology, Innovation and Informatics Committee of the Federal Senate
org:cct-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on scientific and technological development, innovation and informatics.

org:ccti-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on scientific and technological development, innovation and the statistical, cartographic and demographic system.

org:ccult-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on cultural development, historical and artistic heritage, copyright and freedom of expression.

org:cdc-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on consumer relations, consumer protection, the popular economy and the repression of abuse of economic power.

org:cdd-senado.nome: Defence of Democracy Committee of the Federal Senate
org:cdd-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on the defence of democracy and freedom of expression, of the press and political freedom.

org:cde-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on the economic order, international economic relations, the monetary system, foreign exchange and foreign exchange reserves.

org:cdh-senado.nome: Human Rights and Participatory Legislation Committee of the Federal Senate
org:cdh-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on human rights and legislative suggestions from associations, trade unions and civil society organisations.

org:cdhmir-camara.nome: Human Rights, Minorities and Racial Equality Committee
org:cdhmir-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on reports of human rights violations, protection programmes, minorities and racial equality.

org:cdr-senado.nome: Regional Development and Tourism Committee of the Federal Senate
org:cdr-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on regional development and tourism.

org:cdu-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on urban policy, housing, urban land use, planning law and municipal development.

org:ce-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on education in general, education policy and system and funding for education.

org:ce-senado.nome: Education and Culture Committee of the Federal Senate
org:ce-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on education, culture, teaching and the guidelines and framework of national education.

org:centro-de-estudos-e-debates-estrateg.nome: Centre for Strategic Studies and Debates of the Chamber of Deputies
org:centro-de-estudos-e-debates-estrateg.resumo: Technical and advisory body linked to the President of the Chamber that carries out studies on public policies and on the impacts and risks of government plans and projects.

org:cesp-senado.nome: Sport Committee of the Federal Senate
org:cesp-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on general rules for sport and para-sport and the national sports system.

org:cespo-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on the national sports system, general rules for sport and sports justice.

org:cffc-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on taking the accounts of the President of the Republic (CF, art. 51, II), accounting and financial oversight of the Federal Government and reports from the TCU.

org:cft-camara.resumo: Chamber committee that checks whether a bill fits the budget and the budget laws; an unfavourable opinion can end the bill.

org:cgen.resumo: Decision-making, standard-setting and appeals body that regulates access to genetic heritage and traditional knowledge and the sharing of benefits.

org:cgu.resumo: Internal control body of the federal Executive: auditing, disciplinary inspection, integrity, preventing and fighting corruption, and ombudsman services. It has ministry status.

org:ci-senado.nome: Infrastructure Services Committee of the Federal Senate
org:ci-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on transport, public works, mines, telecommunications, public-private partnerships and the sector's regulatory agencies.

org:cics-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on industrial and trade policy, rules for companies, commercial law and industrial property.

org:cidoso-camara.nome: Committee for the Defence of the Rights of Older Persons
org:cidoso-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on the rights of older persons, reports of their violation and public policies for older people.

org:cindre-camara.nome: National Integration and Regional Development Committee
org:cindre-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on the development and integration of the regions, regional plans, regional incentives and territorial planning.

org:cite.resumo: Collegiate body in which the MEC and state and municipal education secretaries negotiate and agree on basic education policy, the minimum quality standard and the Cost per Student for Quality (Custo Aluno Qualidade).

org:clp-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on legislative suggestions from associations, trade unions and civil society organisations, except political parties.

org:cma-senado.nome: Environment Committee of the Federal Senate
org:cma-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on environmental protection, pollution control, natural resources and national environmental policy.

org:cmads-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on national environmental policy, environmental law, natural resources and sustainable development.

org:cmcplp.nome: Joint Committee of the National Congress on Matters Related to the Community of Portuguese-Speaking Countries
org:cmcplp.resumo: Congress committee that links the Brazilian Parliament to the CPLP Parliamentary Assembly and gives opinions on treaties and matters of interest to the Community.

org:cmcvm.nome: Standing Joint Committee to Combat Violence against Women
org:cmcvm.resumo: Standing committee of Congress that identifies failures in services for women victims of violence and proposes measures for the national policy to tackle it.

org:cme-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on mineral and energy policy, energy sources and the prospecting and exploitation of mineral resources.

org:cmmc.nome: Standing Joint Committee on Climate Change
org:cmmc.resumo: Standing committee of Congress that continuously follows, monitors and oversees action on climate change in Brazil.

org:cmmir.nome: Standing Joint Committee on International Migration and Refugees
org:cmmir.resumo: Standing committee of Congress that follows and oversees issues of migration flows at the borders and the rights of refugees.

org:cmn.resumo: Collegiate body of the Ministry of Finance that sets currency and credit policy, fixes monetary policy targets and regulates the financial system.

org:cmo.nome: Joint Committee on Plans, Public Budgets and Oversight
org:cmo.resumo: Standing committee of deputies and senators that gives opinions on the budget laws and on the President's accounts and monitors budget execution.

org:cmulher-camara.nome: Committee for the Defence of Women's Rights
org:cmulher-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on women's rights, reports of violence and protection programmes.

org:cnbs.resumo: Council of Ministers chaired by the Chief of Staff (Casa Civil) that makes the final decision on the commercial use of GMOs, on socio-economic and national interest grounds.

org:cndh.resumo: Council with equal government and civil society membership that receives reports of human rights violations, establishes responsibility and applies penalties such as warnings and public censure.

org:cnj.resumo: Judicial body that oversees the administrative and financial conduct of the courts and judges' compliance with their professional duties. It has 15 members, with two-year terms of office.

org:cnmp.nome: National Council of the Public Prosecution Service
org:cnmp.resumo: Oversees the administrative and financial conduct of the Public Prosecution Service of the Union and of the states and its members' compliance with their duties. It has 14 members.

org:cnpcp.nome: National Council for Criminal and Penitentiary Policy
org:cnpcp.resumo: The first body of sentence enforcement listed in the law: proposes criminal policy, sets rules for prisons and for crime statistics and inspects prisons.

org:cnpe.resumo: Collegiate body of the Presidency, chaired by the Minister of Mines and Energy, that proposes national policies and measures for the energy sector to the President.

org:cnsp.resumo: Collegiate body chaired by the Minister of Finance that sets policy and rules for private insurance, reinsurance and mutual asset protection; Susep carries them out.

org:coaf.resumo: The country's financial intelligence unit: receives and analyses suspicious transaction reports, alerts the authorities and punishes those who fail to meet the duties of the money-laundering law.

org:codefat.nome: Deliberative Council of the Workers' Support Fund
org:codefat.resumo: Tripartite collegiate body of the Ministry of Labour and Employment that manages the FAT: approves the annual plan for unemployment insurance and the wage bonus (abono) and the fund's budget proposal.

org:colegio-de-lideres-da-camara.nome: College of Leaders of the Chamber of Deputies
org:colegio-de-lideres-da-camara.resumo: Brings together the leaders of the Majority, the Minority, the parties, the blocs and the Government in the Chamber; decides by consensus or by a majority weighted by the size of each group.

org:colegio-de-procuradores-da-justica-m.resumo: Brings together all active members of the MPM. It draws up the three-name list for choosing the Prosecutor General of Military Justice.

org:colegio-de-procuradores-da-republica.resumo: Brings together all active members of the MPF. It elects part of the Higher Council and draws up the MPF's six-name lists for the STJ and the TRFs.

org:colegio-de-procuradores-do-trabalho.resumo: Brings together all active members of the MPT. It draws up the three-name list for Prosecutor General of Labour and the six-name lists for the TST and the TRTs.

org:colegio-de-procuradores-e-promotores.nome: College of Prosecutors of the MPDFT
org:colegio-de-procuradores-e-promotores.resumo: Brings together all active members of the MPDFT. It draws up the three-name list for Prosecutor General of Justice and the six-name lists for the TJDFT and the STJ.

org:colegio-pedro-ii.resumo: Federal autonomous agency for education in Rio de Janeiro, offering basic education and teacher-training degrees; the Constitution requires it to remain under federal control.

org:comissao-bipartite-do-distrito-feder.nome: Bipartite Commission of the Federal District (environment)
org:comissao-bipartite-do-distrito-feder.resumo: Forum with equal representation of the Executives of the Federal Government and the DF to promote shared and decentralised environmental management between the two.

org:comissao-de-anistia.resumo: Collegiate body of the Ministry of Human Rights and Citizenship that examines applications for political amnesty and advises the Minister on the decision.

org:comissao-de-cooperacao-internacional.nome: International Cooperation Committee of the STJ
org:comissao-de-cooperacao-internacional.resumo: Assists the President with the STJ's international relations and suggests cooperation opportunities.

org:comissao-de-coordenacao-de-controle-.resumo: Collegiate body that coordinates the federal Executive's internal control system, to integrate its bodies and standardise interpretations.

org:comissao-de-coordenacao-do-stf.resumo: Suggests measures to prevent conflicting decisions, make sessions more productive and speed up the publication of judgments.

org:comissao-de-coordenacao-e-documentac.nome: Coordination and Documentation Committee of the STJ
org:comissao-de-coordenacao-e-documentac.resumo: Suggests measures to modernise the court and make sessions more productive, and supervises the STJ's archive, museum and historical records.

org:comissao-de-documentacao-do-stf.resumo: Guides the keeping of the STF's case files, books and documents and maintains records on the Court's history.

org:comissao-de-etica-publica.resumo: Seven-member collegiate body, attached to the President of the Republic, that guides and investigates the ethical conduct of senior federal officials and monitors conflicts of interest of ministers and directors.

org:comissao-de-gestao-da-biblioteca-do-.nome: Library Management Committee of the STJ
org:comissao-de-gestao-da-biblioteca-do-.resumo: Supervises the STJ-Enfam Library and decides on its special collections and on receiving cultural items on loan.

org:comissao-de-jurisprudencia-do-stf.nome: Case Law Committee of the STF
org:comissao-de-jurisprudencia-do-stf.resumo: Handles the dissemination of the STF's case law: selects judgments for the Court's journal and keeps the Súmula (summary of settled case law) up to date.

org:comissao-de-regimento-do-stf.resumo: Proposes amendments to the STF's internal rules and gives opinions on those proposed by other justices and in administrative proceedings.

org:comissao-de-regimento-interno-do-stj.nome: Internal Rules Committee of the STJ
org:comissao-de-regimento-interno-do-stj.resumo: Proposes amendments to the STJ's rules and gives opinions on those proposed by other justices and in administrative proceedings. It has nine justices.

org:comissao-de-tecnologia-da-informacao.nome: Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence and Cybersecurity Committee of the STJ
org:comissao-de-tecnologia-da-informacao.resumo: Proposes technology guidelines for the STJ and supervises IT planning and artificial intelligence solutions.

org:comissao-do-orcamento-da-seguridade-.nome: Commission for the Social Security budget proposals
org:comissao-do-orcamento-da-seguridade-.resumo: Commission of three representatives (health, pensions and social assistance) that, under Lei 8.212/1991, prepares the annual and multi-year budget proposals for social security.

org:comissao-gestora-de-precedentes-do-s.nome: Precedents, Case Law and Collective Actions Management Committee of the STJ
org:comissao-gestora-de-precedentes-do-s.resumo: Handles the STJ's Súmula and precedents, supervises the management of repetitive appeals and proposes topics for the 'relevance of the federal question' filter. It has six justices.

org:comissao-intergestores-tripartite.resumo: Forum where the Federal Government, states and municipalities negotiate and agree on the operational, financial and administrative rules for the shared management of SUS.

org:comissao-intergestores-tripartite-do.resumo: Forum where the Federal Government, states and municipalities negotiate and agree on the management of Suas, such as the sharing of federal social assistance funds.

org:comissao-intergovernamental-de-finan.nome: Intergovernmental Commission for the Financing of Quality Basic Education
org:comissao-intergovernamental-de-finan.resumo: Collegiate body within the MEC, with representatives of the Federal Government, states and municipalities, that sets each year the weightings used to divide Fundeb money.

org:comissao-mista-de-reavaliacao-de-inf.nome: Joint Commission for the Reassessment of Information
org:comissao-mista-de-reavaliacao-de-inf.resumo: Collegiate body of ministers that decides on classified information in the federal Executive: reviews secret and top-secret classifications and decides the final appeal on access requests.

org:comissao-mista-representativa-no-fip.nome: Joint Committee Representing the National Congress at the Inter-Parliamentary Forum of the Americas
org:comissao-mista-representativa-no-fip.resumo: Standing committee of Congress that represents it at the Inter-Parliamentary Forum of the Americas, with the rights and duties of a member.

org:comissao-representativa-do-congresso.nome: Representative Committee of the National Congress
org:comissao-representativa-do-congresso.resumo: Acts on behalf of Congress during the recess: 7 senators and 16 deputies, elected by the Houses at the last ordinary session of each period.

org:comissao-tripartite-nacional.resumo: Forum with equal representation of the Executives of the Federal Government, the states, the DF and the municipalities to promote shared and decentralised environmental management.

org:comissoes-da-camara-dos-deputados.nome: Committees of the Chamber of Deputies
org:comissoes-da-camara-dos-deputados.resumo: Collegiate bodies of deputies that examine bills by subject and, in many cases, approve or reject them without going to the plenary.

org:comissoes-do-senado-federal.resumo: Collegiate bodies of senators that examine bills by subject and may decide on them conclusively, without the plenary.

org:comissoes-especiais-da-camara.nome: Special committees of the Chamber of Deputies
org:comissoes-especiais-da-camara.resumo: Temporary committees set up to give opinions on proposed constitutional amendments, draft codes and bills that concern more than four subject committees.

org:comissoes-externas-da-camara.nome: External committees of the Chamber of Deputies
org:comissoes-externas-da-camara.resumo: Temporary committees that represent the Chamber on authorised missions in Brazil or abroad.

org:comissoes-intersetoriais-do-conselho.nome: Intersectoral commissions of the National Health Council
org:comissoes-intersetoriais-do-conselho.resumo: National commissions linked to the National Health Council that coordinate policies that affect health but depend on other areas of government.

org:comissoes-mistas-do-congresso-nacion.nome: Joint committees of the National Congress
org:comissoes-mistas-do-congresso-nacion.resumo: Collegiate bodies made up of deputies and senators; the bills they draft start sometimes in the Senate, sometimes in the Chamber.

org:comissoes-permanentes-de-integracao-.nome: Standing commissions for integration between health services and educational institutions
org:comissoes-permanentes-de-integracao-.resumo: Commissions that the SUS Law requires to be set up to propose priorities and strategies for the training and continuing education of SUS professionals.

org:comite-de-admissibilidade-de-emendas.nome: Committee for Examining the Admissibility of Amendments
org:comite-de-admissibilidade-de-emendas.resumo: Standing committee of the CMO that proposes declaring inadmissible amendments to the budget, LDO and multi-year plan bills, including rapporteur amendments.

org:comite-de-avaliacao-da-receita-da-cm.resumo: Standing committee of the CMO that monitors tax collection and analyses the revenue estimates of the multi-year plan and the budget.

org:comite-de-defesa-da-mulher-contra-as.nome: Committee for the Protection of Women against Moral or Sexual Harassment of the Chamber of Deputies
org:comite-de-defesa-da-mulher-contra-as.resumo: Receives reports of moral or sexual harassment in the Chamber and, if well-founded, sends a report to the Steering Board or the Director-General.

org:comite-de-fiscalizacao-da-execucao-o.nome: Committee for the Assessment, Oversight and Control of Budget Execution
org:comite-de-fiscalizacao-da-execucao-o.resumo: Standing committee of the CMO that monitors budget execution, spending freezes, fiscal targets and fiscal management reports.

org:comite-de-harmonizacao-das-administr.resumo: Collegiate body of 4 representatives of the Federal Revenue Service and 4 of the CGIBS that standardises the regulation and interpretation of the rules common to IBS and CBS.

org:comite-de-obras-com-indicios-de-irre.nome: Committee for Assessing Information on Works and Services with Signs of Serious Irregularities
org:comite-de-obras-com-indicios-de-irre.resumo: Standing committee of the CMO that examines works and services in which the TCU found signs of serious irregularities and proposes updates to the list annexed to the budget.

org:comite-gestor-do-ibs.nome: Management Committee of the Tax on Goods and Services
org:comite-gestor-do-ibs.resumo: Public entity of the states, the DF and the municipalities that jointly administers the IBS: single regulation, collection and distribution among the federal entities.

org:comite-gestor-do-simples-nacional.resumo: Collegiate body attached to the Ministry of Finance, with representatives of the Federal Government, states and municipalities, that regulates the Simples Nacional.

org:conama.resumo: Collegiate body of Sisnama, chaired by the Minister of the Environment, that sets national environmental rules and standards, including the criteria for environmental licensing.

org:conanda.nome: National Council for the Rights of Children and Adolescents
org:conanda.resumo: Council with equal government and civil society membership that sets the general rules of the national policy for the care of children and adolescents, oversees its implementation and manages the national fund for the area.

org:conasems.nome: National Council of Municipal Health Secretariats
org:conasems.resumo: Association of municipal health secretariats, recognised by law as the representative of the municipalities on health matters.

org:conass.resumo: Association of state health secretaries, recognised by law as the representative of the states on health matters.

org:concessionarias-e-permissionarias-de.nome: Public service concessionaires and permit holders
org:concessionarias-e-permissionarias-de.resumo: Private parties that provide public services (energy, highways, ports, airports and others) under delegation from the responsible government, chosen by public tender and subject to regulation and oversight.

org:confaz.resumo: Brings together the Minister of Finance and the finance secretaries of the 26 states and the DF; a state can grant an ICMS exemption or benefit only through a unanimous agreement (convênio) of this council.

org:confederacoes-sindicais-e-entidades-.nome: Trade union confederations and national professional associations
org:confederacoes-sindicais-e-entidades-.resumo: Civil society organisations that the Constitution allows to bring constitutional review actions before the STF: confederations of trade unions and national associations of professional or economic groups.

org:conferencias-de-assistencia-social.resumo: Periodic national, state, district and municipal meetings that assess social assistance and propose guidelines for Suas.

org:conferencias-de-saude.resumo: Meetings held every four years at each level of government, with representatives of social groups, to assess the population's health and propose guidelines for health policy.

org:congresso-nacional.resumo: The federal parliament. It exercises the Legislative Branch and is made up of the Chamber of Deputies and the Federal Senate.

org:conitec.nome: National Commission for the Incorporation of Technologies into SUS
org:conitec.resumo: Collegiate body of the Ministry of Health that analyses requests to add, remove or change medicines, products and procedures in SUS and recommends a decision.

org:consea.nome: National Council for Food and Nutrition Security
org:consea.resumo: Collegiate body of the Presidency that advises the President on policies to guarantee the human right to food and on fighting hunger.

org:conselho-curador-do-fgts.nome: Board of Trustees of the Severance Pay Fund (FGTS)
org:conselho-curador-do-fgts.resumo: Tripartite collegiate body that sets the rules and guidelines of the FGTS, approves its programmes and accounts and monitors Caixa, the fund's operating agent.

org:conselho-da-justica-federal.resumo: Central administrative body of the Federal Justice: supervises the budget and management of the TRFs and federal judges, with powers of inspection and binding decisions.

org:conselho-da-magistratura-do-tjdft.resumo: Collegiate body of the TJDFT with disciplinary powers over the judges of the DF and the Territories, provided for in the law on judicial organisation.

org:conselho-da-republica.resumo: The President's highest advisory body: gives opinions on federal intervention, state of defence, state of siege and serious matters for democratic stability.

org:conselho-de-acompanhamento-e-control.nome: Council for Monitoring and Social Control of Fundeb (Federal Government)
org:conselho-de-acompanhamento-e-control.resumo: Federal council that monitors, before the federal government, the distribution, transfer and use of Fundeb funds.

org:conselho-de-administracao-do-stj.resumo: Collegiate body of the 11 most senior justices of the STJ, chaired by the President, that decides the Court's administrative matters.

org:conselho-de-assessoramento-superior-.nome: Higher Advisory Council of the Public Prosecution Service of the Union
org:conselho-de-assessoramento-superior-.resumo: Collegiate body of the heads of the four branches of the MPU, chaired by the Prosecutor General of the Republic, that gives opinions on matters of common interest to the institution.

org:conselho-de-comunicacao-social.resumo: Auxiliary body of Congress that produces studies, opinions and recommendations on social communication, such as radio, TV, the press and advertising.

org:conselho-de-defesa-nacional.resumo: The President's advisory body on national sovereignty and defence of the democratic State: gives opinions on war and peace, federal intervention, state of defence and state of siege.

org:conselho-de-desenvolvimento-economic.nome: Council for Sustainable Economic and Social Development
org:conselho-de-desenvolvimento-economic.resumo: Collegiate body of the Presidency that advises the President on sustainable economic and social development policies, bringing together government and civil society representatives.

org:conselho-de-etica-da-camara.nome: Ethics and Parliamentary Decorum Council of the Chamber of Deputies
org:conselho-de-etica-da-camara.resumo: Collegiate body of the Chamber that examines deputies' conduct contrary to parliamentary decorum and proposes penalties, including loss of their seat.

org:conselho-de-etica-do-senado.nome: Ethics and Parliamentary Decorum Council of the Federal Senate
org:conselho-de-etica-do-senado.resumo: Collegiate body of the Senate that receives complaints and reports against senators, conducts the disciplinary proceedings and proposes loss of their seat.

org:conselho-de-governo.resumo: Collegiate body of the Presidency that advises the President on setting guidelines for government action; it brings together the Ministers of State.

org:conselho-de-recursos-da-previdencia-.resumo: Collegiate body that decides, at administrative level, appeals against INSS decisions on benefits and other social security claims.

org:conselho-do-programa-de-parcerias-de.nome: Council of the Investment Partnerships Programme
org:conselho-do-programa-de-parcerias-de.resumo: Collegiate body of the Presidency that advises the President on policies for partnerships with the private sector in infrastructure and privatisation.

org:conselho-especial-do-tjdft.resumo: Special body of the Court of Justice of the DF and the Territories, which performs functions of the Full Court. By law it is part of the DF judiciary.

org:conselho-federal-da-oab.nome: Federal Council of the Brazilian Bar Association
org:conselho-federal-da-oab.resumo: Supreme body of the OAB, based in Brasília. It can bring an ADI and nominates lawyers for the CNJ and the CNMP.

org:conselho-militar-de-defesa.resumo: Advises the President, as Supreme Commander, on the use of military resources. It brings together the three Commanders and the Chief of the Joint Staff.

org:conselho-nacional-da-policia-civil.nome: National Council of the Civil Police
org:conselho-nacional-da-policia-civil.resumo: National collegiate body of the chiefs of the civil police forces of the states and the DF, which proposes guidelines for standardisation and exchange between them.

org:conselho-nacional-de-assistencia-soc.resumo: Council with equal government and civil society membership that approves the national social assistance policy, sets rules for the sector's services and monitors the National Social Assistance Fund.

org:conselho-nacional-de-comandantes-ger.nome: National Council of Commanders-General of Military Fire Brigades
org:conselho-nacional-de-comandantes-ger.resumo: National collegiate body of the commanders-general of the military fire brigades of the states and the DF, which proposes guidelines for standardisation and exchange between them.

org:conselho-nacional-de-comandantes-ger.nome: National Council of Commanders-General of the Military Police
org:conselho-nacional-de-comandantes-ger.resumo: National collegiate body of the commanders-general of the military police forces of the states and the DF, which proposes guidelines for standardisation and exchange between them.

org:conselho-nacional-de-educacao.resumo: Collegiate body of the Ministry of Education with standard-setting, decision-making and advisory functions for the Minister. It decides, for example, on the national curriculum guidelines.

org:conselho-nacional-de-politica-cultur.resumo: Council of the National Culture System, with equal government and civil society membership, that approves the guidelines of the National Culture Plan and the National Culture Fund and oversees federal transfers.

org:conselho-nacional-de-previdencia-com.resumo: Collegiate body that regulates closed supplementary pension plans (pension funds): issues the rules that Previc applies and enforces.

org:conselho-nacional-de-previdencia-soc.resumo: Collegiate body that sets general guidelines for social security and monitors its management, with government, retirees, workers and employers (four-party management).

org:conselho-nacional-de-recursos-hidric.resumo: Advisory and decision-making collegiate body of the Ministry of Integration, chaired by the Minister, that sets the National Water Resources Policy and arbitrates conflicts between state councils.

org:conselho-nacional-de-saude.resumo: Permanent decision-making council of SUS at federal level. Half of its members represent users; its resolutions are ratified by the Minister of Health.

org:conselho-nacional-de-seguranca-publi.nome: National Council for Public Security and Social Defence
org:conselho-nacional-de-seguranca-publi.resumo: Advisory collegiate body of Susp, chaired by the Minister of Justice and Public Security, with representatives of the three levels of government, the Judiciary, the Public Prosecution Service, the OAB and civil society.

org:conselho-superior-da-agu.nome: Higher Council of the Office of the Attorney General of the Union
org:conselho-superior-da-agu.resumo: Collegiate body of the AGU that organises the competitive examinations for its careers and the promotion and transfer lists, and decides on confirmation in post after the probationary period.

org:conselho-superior-da-dpu.nome: Higher Council of the Federal Public Defender's Office
org:conselho-superior-da-dpu.resumo: Standard-setting body of the DPU, chaired by the Federal Public Defender General: organises competitive examinations, draws up promotion lists and nominates candidates for Deputy Public Defender General and Inspector General.

org:conselho-superior-do-cgibs.resumo: Highest body of the IBS Management Committee: 27 representatives of the states and the DF and 27 of the municipalities and the DF as a whole.

org:conselho-superior-do-mpdft.nome: Higher Council of the Public Prosecution Service of the Federal District and Territories
org:conselho-superior-do-mpdft.resumo: Standard-setting and disciplinary body of the MPDFT, chaired by the Prosecutor General of Justice: approves internal rules and career rules and draws up the lists for Inspector General and promotion.

org:conselho-superior-do-mpf.nome: Higher Council of the Federal Public Prosecution Service
org:conselho-superior-do-mpf.resumo: Standard-setting and disciplinary body of the MPF, chaired by the PGR: approves internal rules and the rules for competitive examinations and promotion, draws up lists and decides on its members' careers.

org:conselho-superior-do-mpm.nome: Higher Council of the Military Public Prosecution Service
org:conselho-superior-do-mpm.resumo: Standard-setting and disciplinary body of the MPM, made up of the Prosecutor General, the Deputy and all the Deputy Prosecutors General of Military Justice.

org:conselho-superior-do-mpt.nome: Higher Council of the Labour Public Prosecution Service
org:conselho-superior-do-mpt.resumo: Standard-setting and disciplinary body of the MPT, chaired by the Prosecutor General of Labour. It may propose to the PGR the dismissal of the Prosecutor General of Labour.

org:conselhos-de-fiscalizacao-profission.resumo: Federal and regional councils created by law to register and supervise regulated professions, such as medicine, engineering and accounting. They charge annual fees and are accountable to the TCU.

org:conselhos-escolares.resumo: Decision-making collegiate bodies of each public basic education school, with the head teacher and representatives of the school and local community elected by their peers.

org:conselhos-especiais-de-justica.resumo: First-instance collegiate bodies of the Military Justice of the Union that try officers (except general officers) for military crimes. One is formed for each case.

org:conselhos-permanentes-de-justica.resumo: First-instance collegiate bodies of the Military Justice of the Union that try military personnel who are not officers. Each one sits for three months.

org:conselhos-seccionais-da-oab.resumo: The OAB councils in each state and in the DF. Each has its own legal personality, acts in its territory and draws up the lists of lawyers for the local courts.

org:consorcios-publicos.resumo: Entities created by members of the Federation, through a contract ratified by law, to achieve objectives of common interest (e.g. health, waste, transport).

org:consultoria-geral-da-uniao.nome: Office of the Legal Counsel of the Union
org:consultoria-geral-da-uniao.resumo: Body of the AGU that helps the Attorney General advise the President of the Republic on legal matters, with opinions and studies.

org:consultoria-legislativa-da-camara.nome: Legislative Consultancy of the Chamber of Deputies
org:consultoria-legislativa-da-camara.resumo: Body of consultants recruited by competitive examination that gives technical and legislative advice to the Steering Board, the committees, the party leaderships and the deputies.

org:consultorias-juridicas-dos-ministeri.nome: Legal Counsel Offices of the ministries
org:consultorias-juridicas-dos-ministeri.resumo: AGU bodies that give legal advice to each Minister of State and examine calls for tender, contracts and waivers of public tender.

org:contran.resumo: Coordinator of the National Traffic System and its highest standard-setting body: regulates the Traffic Code and sets rules for driving licences, signage and fines.

org:coordenadoria-dos-direitos-da-mulher.nome: Women's Rights Coordination Office of the Chamber of Deputies
org:coordenadoria-dos-direitos-da-mulher.resumo: Organises joint action by women deputies: takes part in party leaders' meetings with the right to speak and vote and speaks for the women's caucus in the Plenary.

org:corregedoria-da-justica-do-df.nome: Office of the Inspector of Justice of the Federal District and Territories
org:corregedoria-da-justica-do-df.resumo: Body of the TJDFT that supervises court services and oversees the DF's notary and registry offices. It is headed by the Inspector, an appellate judge elected by peers.

org:corregedoria-da-justica-militar.nome: Office of the Inspector of Military Justice
org:corregedoria-da-justica-militar.resumo: Body that oversees and guides the Military Justice of the Union, headed by the Vice-President of the STM, with jurisdiction across the country.

org:corregedoria-do-cgibs.nome: Office of the Inspector of the CGIBS
org:corregedoria-do-cgibs.resumo: Investigates disciplinary offences by seconded civil servants and employees of the IBS Management Committee, through inquiries and administrative disciplinary proceedings.

org:corregedoria-do-mpdft.nome: Office of the Inspector General of the Public Prosecution Service of the Federal District and Territories
org:corregedoria-do-mpdft.resumo: Oversees the professional work and conduct of MPDFT members. It is headed by the Inspector General.

org:corregedoria-do-mpf.nome: Office of the Inspector General of the Federal Public Prosecution Service
org:corregedoria-do-mpf.resumo: Oversees the professional work and conduct of MPF members. It is headed by the Inspector General.

org:corregedoria-do-mpm.nome: Office of the Inspector General of the Military Public Prosecution Service
org:corregedoria-do-mpm.resumo: Oversees the professional work and conduct of MPM members. It is headed by the Inspector General.

org:corregedoria-do-mpt.nome: Office of the Inspector General of the Labour Public Prosecution Service
org:corregedoria-do-mpt.resumo: Oversees the professional work and conduct of MPT members. It is headed by the Inspector General.

org:corregedoria-do-tcu.nome: Office of the Inspector of the Federal Court of Accounts
org:corregedoria-do-tcu.resumo: Carries out permanent inspection of the TCU and reports on cases concerning the duties of its ministers, substitute ministers and staff.

org:corregedoria-geral-da-agu.nome: Office of the Inspector General of the Advocacy of the Union
org:corregedoria-geral-da-agu.resumo: Oversees the professional work of AGU members, carries out inspections and coordinates the probationary period.

org:corregedoria-geral-da-dpu.nome: Office of the Inspector General of the Federal Public Defender's Office
org:corregedoria-geral-da-dpu.resumo: Oversees the professional work and conduct of the members and staff of the DPU. It is run by the Inspector General.

org:corregedoria-geral-da-justica-do-tra.nome: Office of the Inspector General of Labour Justice
org:corregedoria-geral-da-justica-do-tra.resumo: Body of the CSJT that inspects the TRTs and decides partial corrective complaints against their acts. It is headed by a justice of the TST.

org:corregedoria-geral-da-justica-federa.nome: Office of the Inspector General of Federal Justice
org:corregedoria-geral-da-justica-federa.resumo: Body of the Council of Federal Justice that oversees and guides the Federal Justice at first and second instance and carries out inspections in the TRFs.

org:corregedoria-geral-eleitoral.nome: Office of the Inspector General of Electoral Justice
org:corregedoria-geral-eleitoral.resumo: Body of the TSE that oversees electoral services across the country. It is headed by the Inspector General, a justice of the STJ elected by the TSE.

org:corregedoria-parlamentar-da-camara.nome: Parliamentary Inspectorate of the Chamber of Deputies
org:corregedoria-parlamentar-da-camara.resumo: Safeguards decorum, order and discipline in the Chamber and opens inquiries into offences involving deputies.

org:corregedoria-parlamentar-do-senado.nome: Parliamentary Inspectorate of the Federal Senate
org:corregedoria-parlamentar-do-senado.resumo: Safeguards decorum, order and discipline in the Senate and inquires into reports of offences involving senators.

org:correios.resumo: Federal state-owned company that provides the postal service, which the Constitution requires the Union to maintain.

org:corte-especial-do-stj.resumo: Special body of the STJ, made up of the 15 most senior justices and chaired by the President. It tries governors, appellate judges and other authorities.

org:corte-interamericana-de-direitos-hum.resumo: International court that rules on whether a State has violated the American Convention on Human Rights. Brazil accepts its jurisdiction for events after 10/12/1998.

org:cpasf-camara.nome: Social Security, Social Assistance, Childhood, Adolescence and Family Committee
org:cpasf-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on public and private pensions, social assistance, childhood, adolescence and the family.

org:cpd-camara.nome: Committee for the Defence of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities
org:cpd-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on the rights of persons with disabilities and reports of their violation.

org:cpis-da-camara-dos-deputados.nome: Parliamentary committees of inquiry of the Chamber (CPIs)
org:cpis-da-camara-dos-deputados.resumo: Temporary committees that investigate a specific matter for a fixed period, with the investigative powers of a judicial authority; set up at the request of 1/3 of the deputies.

org:cpis-do-senado-federal.nome: Parliamentary committees of inquiry of the Senate (CPIs)
org:cpis-do-senado-federal.resumo: Temporary committees that investigate a specific matter for a fixed period, with the investigative powers of a judicial authority; set up at the request of 1/3 of the senators.

org:cpmis-do-congresso-nacional.resumo: CPIs made up of equal numbers of deputies and senators, set up at the request of 1/3 of the members of each House.

org:cpovos-camara.nome: Amazon and Indigenous and Traditional Peoples Committee
org:cpovos-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on the Amazon region, Indigenous affairs and lands traditionally occupied by Indigenous peoples.

org:cra-senado.nome: Agriculture and Land Reform Committee of the Federal Senate
org:cra-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on agrarian law, agricultural and land policy, agriculture, livestock and food supply.

org:cre-senado.nome: Foreign Relations and National Defence Committee of the Federal Senate
org:cre-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on international acts and relations, foreign trade, the Armed Forces and national defence.

org:creden.nome: Foreign Relations and National Defence Chamber
org:creden.resumo: Chamber of the Government Council that advises the President on foreign relations and national defence; it supervises the implementation of the National Intelligence Policy.

org:credn-camara.nome: Foreign Relations and National Defence Committee
org:credn-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on foreign policy, international treaties, the Armed Forces and national defence.

org:crsfn.nome: Appeals Council of the National Financial System
org:crsfn.resumo: Final administrative instance for appeals against penalties imposed by the Central Bank, the CVM and Coaf; it has eight members, half from government and half from the market.

org:csaude-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on health in general, the institutional organisation of health and the Unified Health System.

org:csjt.resumo: Central administrative body of Labour Justice: supervises the budget, finances, assets and management of the TRTs and labour courts, with binding decisions.

org:csp-senado.nome: Public Security Committee of the Federal Senate
org:csp-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on public security and the civil, military, federal, federal highway and federal railway police forces.

org:cspcco-camara.nome: Public Security and Combating Organised Crime Committee
org:cspcco-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on public security and its bodies, combating organised crime, drugs and money laundering, and arms control.

org:ctfc-senado.nome: Transparency, Governance, Oversight and Control and Consumer Protection Committee of the Federal Senate
org:ctfc-senado.resumo: Standing committee of the Senate on oversight and control of the acts of the Executive Branch, transparency, governance and consumer protection.

org:ctnbio.resumo: Commission of 27 experts that analyses the risk of GMOs case by case; its technical decision on biosafety is binding on other federal bodies.

org:ctrab-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on labour law, labour relations and occupational safety and health.

org:ctur-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on tourism policy, the national tourism system and tourist activities.

org:cvt-camara.resumo: Standing committee of the Chamber on the national transport network and air, waterway, rail, road and urban transport.

org:diretoria-executiva-do-cgibs.resumo: Technical and executive body of the IBS Management Committee, headed by the Executive Director and made up of the heads of nine directorates.

org:diretoria-geral-da-camara.nome: Directorate-General of the Chamber of Deputies
org:diretoria-geral-da-camara.resumo: Heads the Chamber's administrative services; the Director-General authorises the House's expenditure.

org:diretorias-do-cgibs.resumo: The nine directorates of the Executive Board of the IBS Management Committee: Inspection, Collection and Recovery, Taxation, Information, IT, Credit Review, Administration, Legal Offices and Treasury.

org:dpu.resumo: Provides free legal advice and defence to people who cannot pay, in cases before the Federal, Labour, Electoral and Military courts and the superior courts.

org:eleitorado-nacional.resumo: All Brazilians registered as voters. They elect the President, the Vice-President, federal deputies and senators, and vote in plebiscites and referendums.

org:empresas-estatais-federais.resumo: State-owned companies and mixed-capital companies of the Union, with the governance required by the State-Owned Enterprises Law: board of directors, executive board, fiscal council and audit committee.

org:enamat.nome: National School for the Training and Development of Labour Judges
org:enamat.resumo: School attached to the TST that regulates the official courses for entry and promotion in the career of labour judge.

org:enap.nome: National School of Public Administration Foundation
org:enap.resumo: Federal public foundation for the training and development of civil servants; it is one of the government schools that the Constitution requires the Union to maintain.

org:enfam.nome: National School for the Training and Development of Judges
org:enfam.resumo: School attached to the STJ that regulates the official courses required for entry and promotion in the judicial career.

org:escola-superior-do-mpu.nome: Higher School of the Public Prosecution Service of the Union
org:escola-superior-do-mpu.resumo: School for the training and development of MPU members and staff, reporting directly to the Prosecutor General of the Republic.

org:estado-maior-conjunto-das-forcas-arm.nome: Joint Staff of the Armed Forces
org:estado-maior-conjunto-das-forcas-arm.resumo: Permanent advisory body to the Minister of Defence that plans the joint use of the three Forces.

org:exercito.resumo: The land force: one of the three Armed Forces, directed and managed by the Commander of the Army.

org:federacao-brasil-da-esperanca.resumo: Party federation formed by PT, PCdoB and PV, registered with the TSE on 24/5/2022. It acts as a single party in elections and in Parliament.

org:federacao-psdb-cidadania.resumo: Party federation formed by PSDB and Cidadania, registered with the TSE on 26/5/2022. It acts as a single party in elections and in Parliament.

org:federacao-psol-rede.resumo: Party federation formed by PSOL and Rede Sustentabilidade, registered with the TSE on 26/5/2022. It acts as a single party in elections and in Parliament.

org:federacao-renovacao-solidaria.resumo: Party federation formed by PRD and Solidariedade, registered with the TSE on 4/12/2025. It acts as a single party in elections and in Parliament.

org:federacao-uniao-progressista.resumo: Party federation formed by União Brasil and Progressistas (PP), registered with the TSE on 26/3/2026. It acts as a single party in elections and in Parliament.

org:fnde.resumo: Federal autonomous agency of the Ministry of Education that funds education programmes and distributes the revenue from the education payroll contribution (salário-educação) to the Federal Government, states and municipalities.

org:forcas-armadas.resumo: Navy, Army and Air Force: permanent institutions, under the supreme authority of the President and subordinate to the Minister of Defence, to defend the homeland and guarantee the constitutional powers.

org:forum-de-harmonizacao-juridica-das-p.nome: Legal Harmonisation Forum of the Attorneys' Offices
org:forum-de-harmonizacao-juridica-das-p.resumo: Collegiate body of 4 National Treasury attorneys and 4 state and municipal attorneys that examines legal disputes about IBS and CBS.

org:funai.resumo: Federal Indigenous affairs body: conducts studies to identify and demarcate Indigenous lands, protects Indigenous peoples and exercises police powers on those lands.

org:fundacoes-partidarias.resumo: Private-law foundations or institutes that each party creates for study, research, doctrinal training and political education. They receive at least 20% of the party's share of the Party Fund.

org:funpresp-exe.nome: Supplementary Pension Foundation for Federal Civil Servants of the Executive Branch
org:funpresp-exe.resumo: Pension fund for federal Executive civil servants: manages the supplementary pension plans of those who earn above the General Regime ceiling.

org:gabinete-de-seguranca-institucional.nome: Institutional Security Office of the Presidency of the Republic
org:gabinete-de-seguranca-institucional.resumo: Body of the Presidency that assists the President on military and security matters and is responsible for the security of the President and the Vice-President. Its head is a Minister of State.

org:gabinete-pessoal-do-presidente.nome: Personal Office of the President of the Republic
org:gabinete-pessoal-do-presidente.resumo: Body of the Presidency that assists the President directly and immediately: schedule, private secretariat, protocol, aides-de-camp and personal matters.

org:ibama.nome: Brazilian Institute of Environment and Renewable Natural Resources
org:ibama.resumo: Federal autonomous agency that licenses projects under federal jurisdiction, inspects and punishes environmental offences and exercises environmental police powers.

org:ibge.nome: Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics Foundation
org:ibge.resumo: Federal public foundation that produces official statistics and maps, such as the census; organising these services is a federal responsibility.

org:icmbio.nome: Chico Mendes Institute for Biodiversity Conservation
org:icmbio.resumo: Federal autonomous agency that proposes, sets up, manages, protects and inspects the protected areas created by the Federal Government.

org:imprensa-nacional.resumo: Body of the Chief of Staff's Office (Casa Civil) that publishes the Official Gazette of the Union, where federal laws are published.

org:incra.nome: National Institute for Colonisation and Land Reform
org:incra.resumo: Federal autonomous agency that carries out land reform, handles the regularisation of rural land tenure and grants title to quilombola territories.

org:inep.nome: Anísio Teixeira National Institute for Educational Studies and Research
org:inep.resumo: Federal autonomous agency of the Ministry of Education that produces education statistics and runs national assessments and examinations for basic and higher education.

org:inspetoria-geral-das-policias-milita.nome: General Inspectorate of the Military Police and Military Fire Brigades
org:inspetoria-geral-das-policias-milita.resumo: Body of the Army Command that centralises matters concerning the military police and military fire brigades as auxiliary and reserve forces of the Army.

org:inss.resumo: Federal autonomous agency that operates the General Social Security Regime: recognises entitlement, grants and pays retirement pensions, survivors' pensions and other benefits, as well as social assistance benefits.
