org:instituicao-fiscal-independente.resumo: Senate body that publishes estimates and analyses of the public accounts, monitors compliance with fiscal targets and projects the path of public debt.

org:instituto-de-formacao-do-tjdft.nome: Institute for Training, Professional Development and Research of the TJDFT
org:instituto-de-formacao-do-tjdft.resumo: School of judicial administration of the DF and the Territories, which trains and develops the judges and staff of the TJDFT.

org:instituto-serzedello-correa.resumo: The TCU's school: runs the competitive examinations and training courses for the Court's careers, trains staff and maintains a library and documentation centre.

org:juizados-especiais-estaduais.nome: Special courts of the states and the DF
org:juizados-especiais-estaduais.resumo: Courts for simple civil cases, minor criminal offences and claims against the state, DF or municipality up to 60 minimum wages, with an oral and fast procedure.

org:juizados-especiais-federais.resumo: Federal Justice courts for claims against the Union, federal autonomous agencies, foundations and state-owned companies up to 60 minimum wages, and for minor criminal offences.

org:juntas-eleitorais.resumo: Temporary bodies of the Electoral Justice that count the votes from the electoral zones and certify the winners in the municipalities. Each has a state judge and 2 or 4 citizens.

org:justica-de-paz.resumo: Elected justices of the peace, with 4-year terms of office, who celebrate marriages, process marriage applications and conduct conciliation, without deciding cases.

org:justica-desportiva.resumo: Non-state tribunals, attached to sports organisations, that decide disciplinary offences and competition issues; the Judiciary only hears these cases after them.

org:justica-do-trabalho.resumo: Branch of the Judiciary that decides cases arising from employment relationships, including strikes and trade union disputes. Made up of the TST, the TRTs and labour judges.

org:justica-eleitoral.resumo: Branch of the Judiciary specialised in electoral matters. Made up of the TSE, the TREs, electoral judges and electoral boards.

org:justica-estadual.nome: Justice of the States and the Federal District
org:justica-estadual.resumo: Branch of the Judiciary organised by each state, with a State Court of Justice and state judges. The Justice of the Federal District is organised and funded by the Union.

org:justica-federal.resumo: Branch of the Judiciary that generally decides cases of interest to the Union, its autonomous agencies and state-owned companies. Made up of the Federal Regional Courts and federal judges.

org:justica-militar-da-uniao.resumo: Branch of the Judiciary that tries the military crimes defined by law. Made up of the Superior Military Court and the military courts and judges established by law.

org:liderancas-da-camara-dos-deputados.nome: Party leaderships of the Chamber of Deputies
org:liderancas-da-camara-dos-deputados.resumo: The leaders and deputy leaders of each party or bloc with the minimum number of seats in the Chamber, plus the Government and Minority leaderships.

org:liderancas-do-congresso-nacional.resumo: The leaders who act in joint sessions: of the Government, the Majority, the Minority and the Opposition in Congress, as well as the party leaders of each House.

org:liderancas-do-senado-federal.nome: Party leaderships of the Federal Senate
org:liderancas-do-senado-federal.resumo: The leaders and deputy leaders of the Senate's parties and blocs, of the Majority, the Minority, the Government, the Opposition and the women's caucus.

org:marinha.resumo: The naval force: one of the three Armed Forces, directed and managed by the Commander of the Navy.

org:mesa-da-camara-dos-deputados.nome: Steering Board of the Chamber of Deputies
org:mesa-da-camara-dos-deputados.resumo: Governing committee of the Chamber: directs the House's legislative work and administrative services.

org:mesa-do-congresso-nacional.nome: Steering Board of the National Congress
org:mesa-do-congresso-nacional.resumo: Governing board of the National Congress. It is chaired by the President of the Federal Senate.

org:mesa-do-senado-federal.nome: Steering Board of the Federal Senate
org:mesa-do-senado-federal.resumo: Governing body of the Senate, made up of the President, two Vice-Presidents and four Secretaries.

org:mesas-receptoras-de-votos.resumo: One board per polling station, made up of voters appointed by the electoral judge, that receives the votes on election day.

org:ministerio-da-agricultura-e-pecuaria.resumo: Responsible for agricultural policy and farm production, animal and plant health protection and the safety of food of agricultural origin.

org:ministerio-da-ciencia-tecnologia-e-i.nome: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation
org:ministerio-da-ciencia-tecnologia-e-i.resumo: Responsible for science, technology and innovation policies, digital transformation, biosafety and space policy.

org:ministerio-da-cultura.resumo: Responsible for national policy on culture and the arts, protection of historical and cultural heritage and the regulation of copyright.

org:ministerio-da-defesa.resumo: Responsible for national defence policy and strategy and for the preparation and use of the Armed Forces. Its head must be Brazilian-born.

org:ministerio-da-educacao.resumo: Responsible for national education policy, from early childhood to higher education, and for educational assessment and research.

org:ministerio-da-fazenda.resumo: Responsible for economic policy: currency and credit, taxation and revenue collection, financial administration and the public debt of the Union.

org:ministerio-da-gestao-e-da-inovacao-e.nome: Ministry of Management and Innovation in Public Services
org:ministerio-da-gestao-e-da-inovacao-e.resumo: Responsible for federal public management: civilian personnel, innovation and digital transformation of services, institutional organisation and the Union's real estate.

org:ministerio-da-igualdade-racial.resumo: Responsible for racial and ethnic equality policies, affirmative action and combating racism.

org:ministerio-da-integracao-e-do-desenv.nome: Ministry of Integration and Regional Development
org:ministerio-da-integracao-e-do-desenv.resumo: Responsible for national regional development policy, civil protection and defence, and irrigation policy.

org:ministerio-da-justica-e-seguranca-pu.nome: Ministry of Justice and Public Security
org:ministerio-da-justica-e-seguranca-pu.resumo: Responsible for defending the legal order and constitutional guarantees, judicial policy and public security.

org:ministerio-da-pesca-e-aquicultura.resumo: Responsible for national fisheries and aquaculture policy and the sustainable use of fishery resources.

org:ministerio-da-previdencia-social.resumo: Responsible for social security and supplementary pensions.

org:ministerio-da-saude.resumo: Responsible for national health policy; coordinates and oversees the Unified Health System (SUS).

org:ministerio-das-cidades.resumo: Responsible for urban development policy and for housing, sanitation and urban mobility policies.

org:ministerio-das-comunicacoes.resumo: Responsible for policies on telecommunications, broadcasting, connectivity and digital inclusion, and for postal services.

org:ministerio-das-mulheres.resumo: Responsible for policies for women and for guaranteeing their rights.

org:ministerio-das-relacoes-exteriores.resumo: Assists the President in relations with foreign States and international organisations and is responsible for foreign policy.

org:ministerio-de-minas-e-energia.resumo: Responsible for policies on geology, mining, electricity, oil, gas and biofuels.

org:ministerio-de-portos-e-aeroportos.resumo: Responsible for waterway and air transport policies and for the ports and airports sector.

org:ministerio-do-desenvolvimento-agrari.nome: Ministry of Agrarian Development and Family Farming
org:ministerio-do-desenvolvimento-agrari.resumo: Responsible for land reform, regularisation of land tenure in rural areas and policies for family farming.

org:ministerio-do-desenvolvimento-e-assi.nome: Ministry of Development and Social Assistance, Family and Fight against Hunger
org:ministerio-do-desenvolvimento-e-assi.resumo: Responsible for policies on social development, social assistance, food security and citizenship income.

org:ministerio-do-desenvolvimento-indust.nome: Ministry of Development, Industry, Trade and Services
org:ministerio-do-desenvolvimento-indust.resumo: Responsible for policies on industry, trade and services, foreign trade and intellectual property.

org:ministerio-do-empreendedorismo.nome: Ministry of Entrepreneurship, Micro and Small Enterprises
org:ministerio-do-empreendedorismo.resumo: Responsible for policies supporting entrepreneurship, micro and small enterprises and handicrafts.

org:ministerio-do-esporte.resumo: Responsible for sports policies and the promotion of sporting activities.

org:ministerio-do-meio-ambiente-e-mudanc.nome: Ministry of the Environment and Climate Change
org:ministerio-do-meio-ambiente-e-mudanc.resumo: Responsible for national environmental policy and policy on climate change, biodiversity and forests.

org:ministerio-do-planejamento-e-orcamen.resumo: Responsible for long-term planning, evaluation of public policies and the federal budget.

org:ministerio-do-trabalho-e-emprego.resumo: Responsible for employment and income policies, labour relations and labour inspection.

org:ministerio-do-turismo.resumo: Responsible for national tourism policy and the promotion of tourism in Brazil and abroad.

org:ministerio-dos-direitos-humanos-e-da.nome: Ministry of Human Rights and Citizenship
org:ministerio-dos-direitos-humanos-e-da.resumo: Responsible for policies to promote human rights, such as those of older persons, children and adolescents and persons with disabilities.

org:ministerio-dos-povos-indigenas.resumo: Responsible for Indigenous policy and for guaranteeing the rights and lands of Indigenous peoples.

org:ministerio-dos-transportes.resumo: Responsible for rail and road transport policies and the national traffic policy.

org:ministerio-publico-da-uniao.nome: Public Prosecution Service of the Union
org:ministerio-publico-da-uniao.resumo: Federal branch of the Public Prosecution Service, made up of the MPF, MPT, MPM and MPDFT and headed by the Prosecutor General of the Republic.

org:ministerio-publico-eleitoral.resumo: Public Prosecution Service functions before the Electoral Justice, exercised by the MPF at all stages and levels and, in the electoral zones, by prosecutors of the state Public Prosecution Services.

org:mp-junto-ao-tcu.nome: Public Prosecution Service at the Federal Court of Accounts
org:mp-junto-ao-tcu.resumo: Special Public Prosecution Service that acts in TCU proceedings as guardian of the law. It is not part of the MPU.

org:mpdft.nome: Public Prosecution Service of the Federal District and Territories
org:mpdft.resumo: Branch of the MPU that acts in cases before the Court of Justice and the judges of the Federal District and Territories.

org:mpf.resumo: Branch of the MPU that acts in cases before the STF, the STJ, the Federal Justice and the Electoral Justice. It is headed by the Prosecutor General of the Republic.

org:mpm.resumo: Branch of the MPU that acts before the Military Justice of the Union. It is headed by the Prosecutor General of Military Justice.

org:mpt.resumo: Branch of the MPU that acts before the Labour Justice. It is headed by the Prosecutor General of Labour.

org:nucleo-de-seguranca-e-credenciamento.resumo: GSI unit that accredits people, companies and bodies to handle classified information and is responsible for the security of that information, including information received from other countries.

org:oab.resumo: Organisation that represents, selects and disciplines lawyers in the country. The law defines it as a public service, with no functional or hierarchical link to the public administration.

org:organismos-internacionais.nome: International organisations of which Brazil is a member
org:organismos-internacionais.resumo: Organisations made up of States to which Brazil belongs by a promulgated treaty, such as the UN, the OAS, Mercosur and the WTO.

org:organizacoes-sindicais-entidades-de-.nome: Trade unions, professional associations and associations
org:organizacoes-sindicais-entidades-de-.resumo: Trade unions, professional associations and associations that have been operating for at least one year, which may file collective writs of mandamus (mandado de segurança) and collective writs of injunction (mandado de injunção) on behalf of their members.

org:organizacoes-sociais.resumo: Private non-profit entities that the Executive Branch qualifies to work in education, research, technology, the environment, culture and health with public funds, under a management contract.

org:orgaos-setoriais-de-administracao-fi.resumo: Financial programming units of each ministry, the AGU, the Vice-Presidency and the Casa Civil, under the technical guidance of the National Treasury Secretariat.

org:orgaos-setoriais-de-contabilidade.resumo: Internal management units of each ministry and the AGU that keep the federal accounts under the technical guidance of the National Treasury Secretariat.

org:orgaos-setoriais-de-controle-interno.resumo: The internal control units of Itamaraty, the Ministry of Defence, the AGU and the Casa Civil, outside the CGU's direct action but under its technical supervision.

org:orgaos-setoriais-de-planejamento-e-o.resumo: Planning and budget units of each ministry, the AGU, the Vice-Presidency and the Casa Civil, which follow the technical guidance of the system's central body.

org:oscips.nome: Civil society organisations of public interest
org:oscips.resumo: Private non-profit entities qualified by the Ministry of Justice to sign partnership agreements with the government in areas such as social assistance, culture, health and education.

org:ouvidoria-do-senado-federal.nome: Ombudsman's Office of the Federal Senate
org:ouvidoria-do-senado-federal.resumo: Receives suggestions, criticism, complaints and signed reports from citizens about the Senate's activities and replies within 30 working days.

org:ouvidoria-geral-da-justica-do-df.nome: Ombudsman's Office of the Justice of the Federal District and Territories
org:ouvidoria-geral-da-justica-do-df.resumo: Channel of the TJDFT for hearing citizens' opinions on the DF's court services and suggesting improvements.

org:ouvidoria-geral-da-previdencia-socia.resumo: Receives and forwards complaints, praise and suggestions about social security and coordinates the technical committee of the ombudsman offices of the entities linked to the Ministry of Social Security.

org:ouvidoria-parlamentar-da-camara.nome: Parliamentary Ombudsman's Office of the Chamber of Deputies
org:ouvidoria-parlamentar-da-camara.resumo: Receives complaints and reports from individuals and organisations about illegal acts, abuses and poor functioning of the Chamber's services and forwards them to those who can act.

org:partido-avante.resumo: Political party with seats in the Chamber of Deputies on 01/10/2026.

org:partido-cidadania.resumo: Political party with seats in the Chamber of Deputies on 01/10/2026.

org:partido-pode.resumo: Political party with seats in the Chamber of Deputies on 01/10/2026.

org:partido-pp.resumo: Political party with seats in the Chamber of Deputies on 01/10/2026.

org:partido-prd.resumo: Political party with seats in the Chamber of Deputies on 01/10/2026.

org:partido-psb.resumo: National political party, registered by the TSE in 1988. Ballot number: 40.

org:partido-psd.resumo: Political party with seats in the Chamber of Deputies on 01/10/2026.

org:partido-psdb.resumo: Political party with seats in the Chamber of Deputies on 01/10/2026.

org:partido-psol.resumo: Political party with seats in the Chamber of Deputies on 01/10/2026.

org:partido-pt.resumo: National political party, registered by the TSE in 1982. Ballot number: 13.

org:partido-pv.resumo: Political party with seats in the Chamber of Deputies on 01/10/2026.

org:partido-rede.resumo: Political party with seats in the Chamber of Deputies on 01/10/2026.

org:partido-republicanos.resumo: National political party, registered with the TSE in 2005 as PRB. Ballot number: 10.

org:partido-solidariedade.resumo: Political party with seats in the Chamber of Deputies on 01/10/2026.

org:partido-uniao.resumo: National political party, created in 2022 by the merger of DEM and PSL. Ballot number: 44.

org:partidos-politicos.resumo: All parties registered with the TSE. National private-law legal entities that field the candidates: without party membership no one can be elected.

org:pe-distrito-estadual-de-fernando-de-.nome: State District of Fernando de Noronha
org:pe-distrito-estadual-de-fernando-de-.resumo: Territorial autonomous agency of the State of Pernambuco that governs the archipelago in place of a municipality. It is headed by an administrator-general appointed by the governor.

org:petrobras.resumo: Federal mixed-capital oil and gas company: a joint-stock company in which the Union holds the majority of the voting shares.

org:pgfn.nome: Office of the Attorney General of the National Treasury
org:pgfn.resumo: AGU body that registers and collects the Union's outstanding tax debts and represents it in tax cases.

org:plenario-da-camara-dos-deputados.nome: Plenary of the Chamber of Deputies
org:plenario-da-camara-dos-deputados.resumo: Meeting of all federal deputies, which debates and votes on bills when the committees do not decide on their own.

org:plenario-do-senado-federal.resumo: Meeting of all senators, which debates and votes on bills that are not decided conclusively in the committees.

org:plenario-do-stf.resumo: Meeting of the 11 justices of the STF, chaired by the President of the Court. It decides the most important cases, such as constitutional review actions.

org:plenario-do-stj.resumo: Meeting of the 33 justices of the STJ, chaired by the President. It deals mainly with elections, lists and internal rules; deciding cases is up to the Special Court, the Sections and the Panels.

org:plenario-do-tcu.nome: Plenary of the Federal Court of Accounts
org:plenario-do-tcu.resumo: Meeting of the nine ministers of the TCU, led by the President; it decides the most important matters, such as the opinion on the accounts of the President of the Republic.

org:poder-executivo-federal.resumo: One of the three Branches of the Union. It is exercised by the President of the Republic, assisted by the Ministers of State.

org:poder-judiciario.resumo: One of the three Branches. It includes the STF, the CNJ, the superior courts and the Federal, Labour, Electoral and Military Justice and the Justice of the states and the DF.

org:poder-legislativo-federal.resumo: One of the three Branches of the Union. It is exercised by the National Congress, made up of the Chamber of Deputies and the Federal Senate.

org:policia-federal.resumo: The Union's judicial police: investigates crimes against federal property and interests and crimes with interstate or international impact, and acts as maritime, airport and border police.

org:policia-ferroviaria-federal.resumo: Provided for in the Constitution to patrol federal railways, but with no body in operation: it does not appear in the structure of the Ministry of Justice and Public Security.

org:policia-penal-federal.resumo: Responsible for security in federal prisons. It is organised and funded by the Union and attached to the body that runs the federal prison system.

org:policia-rodoviaria-federal.resumo: Carries out visible patrolling of federal highways. It is a permanent body, organised and funded by the Union and structured as a career.

org:presidencia-da-republica.resumo: The body heading the federal Executive: it brings together the President of the Republic and the bodies that assist the President directly, such as the Casa Civil.

org:presidencia-do-stf.resumo: Body of the STF exercised by the President of the Court: represents the STF, directs its work and rules on cases before they are assigned to a justice.

org:presidencia-do-stj.resumo: Governing body of the STJ, exercised by the President: represents the Court, chairs the Plenary, the Special Court and the CJF and rules on cases before they are assigned to a justice.

org:previc.resumo: Federal autonomous agency that supervises pension funds (closed supplementary pension entities), authorises them to operate and may intervene in them.

org:primeira-camara-do-tcu.nome: First Chamber of the Federal Court of Accounts
org:primeira-camara-do-tcu.resumo: Collegiate body of four TCU ministers that decides, among other matters, accounts and personnel acts that are not reserved to the Plenary.

org:primeira-secao-do-stj.resumo: One of the STJ's three specialised Sections, made up of the First and Second Panels. Area: public law.

org:primeira-turma-do-stf.resumo: One of the STF's two Panels, of five justices each. It decides, among others, habeas corpus, complaints (reclamações) and extraordinary appeals that do not go to the Plenary.

org:primeira-turma-do-stj.resumo: Specialised panel of the STJ, with five justices, part of the First Section. It mainly decides special appeals and habeas corpus.

org:procuradoria-da-mulher-da-camara.nome: Women's Advocate Office of the Chamber of Deputies
org:procuradoria-da-mulher-da-camara.resumo: Receives reports of violence and discrimination against women and oversees federal gender equality programmes.

org:procuradoria-especial-da-mulher-do-s.nome: Special Women's Advocate Office of the Federal Senate
org:procuradoria-especial-da-mulher-do-s.resumo: Defends women's rights in the Senate, receives reports of violence and discrimination and oversees federal gender equality programmes.

org:procuradoria-geral-da-uniao.nome: Office of the Attorney General for the Union
org:procuradoria-geral-da-uniao.resumo: AGU body that represents the Union in court, except in tax cases, which fall to the PGFN.

org:procuradoria-geral-federal.nome: Office of the Federal Attorney General
org:procuradoria-geral-federal.resumo: Represents federal autonomous agencies and public foundations in court and gives them legal advice. It is attached to the AGU and has administrative and financial autonomy.

org:procuradoria-parlamentar-da-camara.nome: Parliamentary Advocate's Office of the Chamber of Deputies
org:procuradoria-parlamentar-da-camara.resumo: Defends the Chamber, its bodies and its deputies when their honour or image is attacked because of their mandate.

org:procuradoria-parlamentar-do-senado.nome: Parliamentary Advocate's Office of the Federal Senate
org:procuradoria-parlamentar-do-senado.resumo: Defends the Senate, its bodies and its senators when their honour or image is attacked because of their mandate, in cooperation with the Steering Board.

org:quarta-turma-do-stj.resumo: Specialised panel of the STJ, with five justices, part of the Second Section. It mainly decides special appeals and habeas corpus.

org:quinta-turma-do-stj.resumo: Specialised panel of the STJ, with five justices, part of the Third Section. It mainly decides special appeals and habeas corpus.

org:receita-federal.nome: Special Secretariat of the Federal Revenue of Brazil
org:receita-federal.resumo: Body of the Ministry of Finance that administers federal taxes and customs: inspects, assesses, charges and collects.

org:representacao-brasileira-no-parlamen.nome: Brazilian Representation in the Mercosur Parliament
org:representacao-brasileira-no-parlamen.resumo: Congress body that links the Brazilian Parliament to the Mercosur Parliament and gives opinions on matters of interest to the bloc.

org:secretaria-da-inovacao-legislativa-d.nome: Legislative Innovation Secretariat of the Chamber of Deputies
org:secretaria-da-inovacao-legislativa-d.resumo: Proposes innovation initiatives in the Chamber and studies legislation on innovation in the public and private sectors.

org:secretaria-da-mulher-da-camara.nome: Women's Secretariat of the Chamber of Deputies
org:secretaria-da-mulher-da-camara.resumo: Political body of the Chamber that works for women's rights and gender equality; it brings together the Women's Advocate Office and the Women's Rights Coordination Office.

org:secretaria-da-primeira-infancia-infa.nome: Early Childhood, Childhood, Adolescence and Youth Secretariat of the Chamber of Deputies
org:secretaria-da-primeira-infancia-infa.resumo: Promotes debates and oversees programmes on the rights of children, adolescents and young people, with the absolute priority of art. 227 of the Constitution.

org:secretaria-da-transparencia-da-camar.nome: Transparency Secretariat of the Chamber of Deputies
org:secretaria-da-transparencia-da-camar.resumo: Supervises compliance with the Access to Information Law in the Chamber and promotes a culture of transparency.

org:secretaria-de-auditoria-interna-do-t.nome: Internal Audit Secretariat of the TCU
org:secretaria-de-auditoria-interna-do-t.resumo: The TCU's internal audit unit: oversees the Court's own accounting, financial, budgetary, operational and asset management.

org:secretaria-de-comunicacao-social.nome: Social Communication Secretariat of the Presidency of the Republic
org:secretaria-de-comunicacao-social.resumo: Body of the Presidency that designs and carries out the communication and publicity policy of the federal Executive. Its head is a Minister of State.

org:secretaria-de-comunicacao-social-da-.nome: Social Communication Secretariat of the Chamber of Deputies
org:secretaria-de-comunicacao-social-da-.resumo: Ensures that parliamentary work is publicised and supervises the Chamber's media outlets.

org:secretaria-de-controle-interno-da-ca.nome: Internal Control Secretariat of the Chamber of Deputies
org:secretaria-de-controle-interno-da-ca.resumo: Internal control unit of the Chamber of Deputies: monitors and oversees the House's accounting, financial, budgetary, operational and asset management.

org:secretaria-de-defesa-das-prerrogativ.nome: Secretariat for the Defence of Parliamentary Prerogatives of the Chamber of Deputies
org:secretaria-de-defesa-das-prerrogativ.resumo: Issues opinions and takes action on the prerogatives and immunities of federal deputies.

org:secretaria-de-monitoramento-das-deci.nome: Secretariat for Monitoring and Oversight of the Decisions of the Inter-American Human Rights System of the Chamber of Deputies
org:secretaria-de-monitoramento-das-deci.resumo: Follows Brazil's compliance with the decisions of the Inter-American Court and Commission of Human Rights and their effects on the Chamber's bills.

org:secretaria-de-orcamento-federal.resumo: Secretariat of the Ministry of Planning and Budget that coordinates the drafting of the LDO and the federal budget bill and guides the sector budget bodies.

org:secretaria-de-participacao-interacao.nome: Participation, Interaction and Digital Media Secretariat of the Chamber of Deputies
org:secretaria-de-participacao-interacao.resumo: Sets the guidelines for the Chamber's presence on digital media and seeks to increase interaction with society through them.

org:secretaria-de-relacoes-institucionai.nome: Institutional Relations Secretariat of the Presidency of the Republic
org:secretaria-de-relacoes-institucionai.resumo: Body of the Presidency responsible for the government's political coordination, including with Congress and with states and municipalities. Its head is a Minister of State.

org:secretaria-de-relacoes-internacionai.nome: International Relations Secretariat of the Chamber of Deputies
org:secretaria-de-relacoes-internacionai.resumo: Sets the guidelines for the Chamber's parliamentary diplomacy and promotes cooperation with foreign parliaments.

org:secretaria-do-empreendedorismo-legis.nome: Legislative Entrepreneurship Secretariat of the Chamber of Deputies
org:secretaria-do-empreendedorismo-legis.resumo: Studies and proposes improvements to legislation on entrepreneurship and follows federal and civil society programmes on the subject.

org:secretaria-do-mpu.nome: Secretariat of the Public Prosecution Service of the Union
org:secretaria-do-mpu.resumo: Provides auxiliary technical and administrative support services to the MPU. It is headed by a Director-General freely chosen by the Prosecutor General of the Republic.

org:secretaria-do-tcu.nome: Secretariat of the Federal Court of Accounts
org:secretaria-do-tcu.resumo: Set of units that gives technical and administrative support to the TCU; its auditors carry out the inspections and audits.

org:secretaria-do-tesouro-nacional.resumo: Body of the Ministry of Finance that manages the Union's cash and public debt and is responsible for federal public accounting.

org:secretaria-federal-de-controle-inter.resumo: CGU secretariat that performs the functions of central body of the federal Executive's internal control: audits, budget evaluation and checking compliance with the LRF limits.

org:secretaria-geral-da-mesa-da-camara.nome: General Secretariat of the Steering Board of the Chamber of Deputies
org:secretaria-geral-da-mesa-da-camara.resumo: Supports the Steering Board in legislative work: compiles the list of certified deputies and sends bills to the committees.

org:secretaria-geral-da-presidencia.nome: General Secretariat of the Presidency of the Republic
org:secretaria-geral-da-presidencia.resumo: Body of the Presidency that manages the government's relations with civil society and coordinates social participation policy. Its head is a Minister of State.

org:secretaria-geral-do-cgibs.resumo: Gives technical and administrative support to the Higher Council and integrates the bodies of the IBS Management Committee; it is headed by the Second Vice-President.

org:secretaria-nacional-de-politicas-pen.resumo: Secretariat of the Ministry of Justice that coordinates national penal policy, runs the federal prisons and manages the National Penitentiary Fund.

org:segunda-camara-do-tcu.nome: Second Chamber of the Federal Court of Accounts
org:segunda-camara-do-tcu.resumo: Collegiate body of four TCU ministers that decides, among other matters, accounts and personnel acts that are not reserved to the Plenary.

org:segunda-secao-do-stj.resumo: One of the STJ's three specialised Sections, made up of the Third and Fourth Panels. Area: private law.

org:segunda-turma-do-stf.resumo: One of the STF's two Panels, of five justices each. It decides, among others, habeas corpus, complaints (reclamações) and extraordinary appeals that do not go to the Plenary.

org:segunda-turma-do-stj.resumo: Specialised panel of the STJ, with five justices, part of the First Section. It mainly decides special appeals and habeas corpus.

org:senado-federal.resumo: House of the representatives of the states and the DF: 81 senators, three per unit, elected by majority vote.

org:servicos-de-informacao-ao-cidadao.resumo: Physical and online desks that each public body and entity maintains to receive requests for access to information and guide the public.

org:sexta-turma-do-stj.resumo: Specialised panel of the STJ, with five justices, part of the Third Section. It mainly decides special appeals and habeas corpus.

org:sisnama.resumo: Brings together the bodies and entities of the Federal Government, the states, the DF and the municipalities responsible for protecting and improving environmental quality.

org:sistema-brasileiro-de-inteligencia.resumo: Network of federal bodies that produce intelligence, coordinated by ABIN, to provide input to the President. States and the DF may join.

org:sistema-de-administracao-financeira-.resumo: Network that manages the Union's cash: financial programming, the Single Treasury Account, and the Treasury's debts and assets. The National Treasury Secretariat is the central body.

org:sistema-de-contabilidade-federal.resumo: Network that records budget execution and the Union's assets and produces the federal balance sheets and the consolidated balance sheet of the public sector. The National Treasury Secretariat is the central body.

org:sistema-de-controle-interno-do-poder.nome: Internal Control System of the Federal Executive Branch
org:sistema-de-controle-interno-do-poder.resumo: Internal audit and oversight network of the federal Executive, which evaluates programmes, budgets and managers and supports the TCU. The CGU is the central body.

org:sistema-de-gestao-da-etica-do-poder-.nome: Ethics Management System of the Federal Executive Branch
org:sistema-de-gestao-da-etica-do-poder-.resumo: Brings together the Public Ethics Commission and the ethics commissions of each body and entity of the federal Executive, to integrate public ethics actions.

org:sistema-de-planejamento-e-de-orcamen.resumo: Network of the federal Executive's planning and budget units that prepare the PPA, the LDO and the LOA, under the guidance of the Ministry of Planning and Budget.

org:sistema-federal-de-ensino.resumo: Includes the schools, universities and institutes run by the Union, private colleges and universities and the federal education bodies.

org:sistema-nacional-de-cultura.resumo: Brings together the Federal Government, the states, the DF and the municipalities that join, with society, to plan and carry out public cultural policies jointly.

org:sistema-nacional-de-educacao.resumo: Links the education systems of the Federal Government, the states, the DF and the municipalities to plan and carry out education policy in collaboration.

org:sistema-s.resumo: Private entities created by law as autonomous social services (Senai, Sesc, Sebrae, Apex-Brasil and others), funded by compulsory contributions or by federal funds.

org:sistema-unico-de-assistencia-social.resumo: Decentralised and participatory system that organises the social assistance of the Federal Government, the states, the DF and the municipalities, with co-financing and shared management.

org:sistema-unico-de-saude.resumo: Single network formed by the public health actions and services of the Federal Government, the states, the DF and the municipalities, with a single management at each level of government.

org:sistema-unico-de-seguranca-publica.resumo: Brings together the public security bodies of the Federal Government, the states, the DF and the municipalities so that they act in an integrated way. It is coordinated by the Ministry of Justice and Public Security.

org:sncti.nome: National System of Science, Technology and Innovation
org:sncti.resumo: System provided for in the Constitution to organise, in collaboration, public and private bodies that promote science, technology and innovation.

org:stf.resumo: The highest court of the Judiciary, whose main duty is to safeguard the Constitution. It has 11 justices.

org:stj.resumo: Superior court that standardises the interpretation of federal law: it decides special appeals against decisions of the TRFs and the State Courts of Justice. It has at least 33 justices.

org:stm.resumo: Superior court of the Military Justice of the Union. It has 15 justices with life tenure: ten general officers from the three Forces and five civilians.

org:subsistema-de-atencao-a-saude-indige.resumo: The part of SUS dedicated to Indigenous peoples, funded by the Federal Government and organised into Special Indigenous Health Districts (Dseis).

org:sudam.nome: Superintendence for the Development of the Amazon
org:sudam.resumo: Federal autonomous agency that plans and carries out regional development actions in Acre, Amapá, Amazonas, Mato Grosso, Rondônia, Roraima, Tocantins, Pará and the part of Maranhão west of the 44th meridian.

org:sudeco.nome: Superintendence for the Development of the Centre-West
org:sudeco.resumo: Federal autonomous agency that plans and carries out regional development actions in Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Goiás and the Federal District.

org:sudene.nome: Superintendence for the Development of the Northeast
org:sudene.resumo: Federal autonomous agency that plans and carries out regional development actions in the nine states of the Northeast and the parts of Minas Gerais and Espírito Santo listed in the law.

org:suframa.nome: Superintendence of the Manaus Free Trade Zone
org:suframa.resumo: Federal autonomous agency based in Manaus that administers the Manaus Free Trade Zone: plans, promotes and coordinates the area's activities and its incentives.

org:tc-df.nome: Court of Accounts of the Federal District
org:tc-df.resumo: Assists the Legislative Chamber with external control of the accounts of the Federal District. Seat: Brasília.

org:tce-ac.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Acre
org:tce-ac.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Acre and the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities. Seat: Rio Branco.

org:tce-al.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Alagoas
org:tce-al.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Alagoas and the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities. Seat: Maceió.

org:tce-am.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Amazonas
org:tce-am.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Amazonas and the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities. Seat: Manaus.

org:tce-ap.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Amapá
org:tce-ap.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Amapá and the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities. Seat: Macapá.

org:tce-ba.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Bahia
org:tce-ba.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the accounts of the state of Bahia. The municipalities are covered by another court. Seat: Salvador.

org:tce-ce.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Ceará
org:tce-ce.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Ceará and the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities. Seat: Fortaleza.

org:tce-es.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Espírito Santo
org:tce-es.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Espírito Santo and the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities. Seat: Vitória.

org:tce-go.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Goiás
org:tce-go.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the accounts of the state of Goiás. The municipalities are covered by another court. Seat: Goiânia.

org:tce-ma.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Maranhão
org:tce-ma.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Maranhão and the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities. Seat: São Luís.

org:tce-mg.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Minas Gerais
org:tce-mg.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Minas Gerais and the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities. Seat: Belo Horizonte.

org:tce-ms.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Mato Grosso do Sul
org:tce-ms.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Mato Grosso do Sul and the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities. Seat: Campo Grande.

org:tce-mt.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Mato Grosso
org:tce-mt.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Mato Grosso and the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities. Seat: Cuiabá.

org:tce-pa.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Pará
org:tce-pa.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the accounts of the state of Pará. The municipalities are covered by another court. Seat: Belém.

org:tce-pb.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Paraíba
org:tce-pb.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Paraíba and the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities. Seat: João Pessoa.

org:tce-pe.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Pernambuco
org:tce-pe.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Pernambuco and the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities. Seat: Recife.

org:tce-pi.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Piauí
org:tce-pi.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Piauí and the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities. Seat: Teresina.

org:tce-pr.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Paraná
org:tce-pr.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Paraná and the Municipal Councils with external control of the municipalities. Seat: Curitiba.

org:tce-rj.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Rio de Janeiro
org:tce-rj.resumo: Assists the State Legislative Assembly with external control of the state of Rio de Janeiro and the Councils of all municipalities except the capital. Seat: Rio de Janeiro.

org:tce-rn.nome: Court of Accounts of the State of Rio Grande do Norte

org:turma-nacional-de-uniformizacao.nome: National Standardisation Panel of the Federal Special Courts
org:turma-nacional-de-uniformizacao.resumo: Collegiate body that standardises the interpretation of federal law when appeal panels of different regions decide differently or against the case law of the STJ.

org:turmas-recursais-estaduais.nome: Appeal panels of the special courts of the states and the DF
org:turmas-recursais-estaduais.resumo: Panels of three first-instance judges that decide appeals against decisions of the state special courts. They are the last ordinary instance for these cases.

org:turmas-recursais-federais.nome: Appeal panels of the federal special courts
org:turmas-recursais-federais.resumo: Panels of first-instance federal judges that decide appeals against decisions of the federal special courts. Each TRF defines the composition and area of its own.

org:unidades-da-dpu-nos-estados.nome: Federal Public Defender's Offices in the states and the DF
org:unidades-da-dpu-nos-estados.resumo: DPU units in each state and in the DF, headed by a Chief Public Defender, which may act through local centres.

org:unidades-orcamentarias-do-poder-exec.nome: Budget units of the federal Executive Branch
org:unidades-orcamentarias-do-poder-exec.resumo: Offices of the federal Executive that receive their own appropriations in the budget and carry out spending: they commit, verify and pay.

org:varas-do-df.nome: Judicial districts and courts of the Federal District
org:varas-do-df.resumo: First instance of the Justice of the DF: specialised courts grouped into judicial districts, with judges and substitute judges.

org:varas-do-trabalho.resumo: First-instance courts of the Labour Justice, each with a single judge. They decide cases between employees and employers.

org:varas-federais.resumo: First-instance courts of the Federal Justice, organised into judicial sections: one per state and one in the DF, based in the capital.

org:vice-presidencia-da-republica.resumo: Unit that supports the Vice-President of the Republic.

org:zonas-eleitorais.resumo: Divisions of each state's territory for electoral services; in each, a state judge exercises electoral jurisdiction. There were 2,641 in 2026.
